failed.question:
A farmer, through an unrecorded written agreement, purchased the right to cut and remove timber from woodlands adjacent to his farm for 10 years. The farmer used the harvested timber for his own needs on the farm, and he cut the timber and sold it as firewood to other members of the community for the first five years after the sale. The farmer died six years after the agreement was formed, devising all of his real property interests to his son.
Immediately before the farmer's death, the owner of the woodlands sold the woodlands to a developer, who promptly recorded the deed. Neither the deed nor the owner of the woodlands mentioned the prior agreement with the farmer. When the developer learned that timber was being harvested from the woodlands by the farmer's son, the developer demanded that the son stop. The son refused, contending that he had a valid profit à prendre. The developer brought an action for an injunction to prevent the son from cutting and removing the timber.
The jurisdiction's recording act states that "no conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice unless the same be recorded according to law."
How is the court likely to rule?

A builder purchased 10 acres of undeveloped land. He intended to construct five homes, and each home was to be constructed on a two-acre lot, which was the minimum size permitted under the zoning regulations. The builder employed an architect to design the basic plan for each home, but the builder was forced to shelve those plans due to a sudden downturn in the economy.
Six years later, the builder engaged a surveyor to subdivide the land into two-acre lots. He then discovered that the local zoning board had validly rezoned the area in which the 10 acres were located a year ago, increasing the minimum lot size to two and one-half acres for new residences. The zoning ordinance does not provide for special exceptions, and the builder cannot profitably construct only four of the five homes designed by the architect.
Can the builder proceed with his plans to build five homes on two-acre lots?

questions.question:
A man owned land along the south side of a highway. To the south of the man's land was a lot owned by a woman who lived on it in a house.
Five years ago, the man conveyed a right-of-way easement over his land to the woman because it provided a more direct route between her house and the highway. The easement was evidenced by a clearly marked path. The document granting the easement was promptly recorded.
Three years ago, the woman conveyed the house to the man. The man never took actual possession of the house.
Two years ago, the man conveyed the house to a purchaser by a warranty deed. Two months after the purchaser moved into the house, a neighbor informed him about the easement. He then began using the path that had been marked on the man's land. When the man noticed the purchaser using the path, he erected a barricade on his land that effectively prevented the purchaser from using the path.
The purchaser has sued the man, claiming that he has an easement over the man's land.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.a: The man, because the easement was extinguished.
choices.b: The man, because the purchaser did not have actual notice of the easement at the time of acquisition.
choices.c: The purchaser, because he purchased the house by warranty deed.
choices.d: The purchaser, because the easement was of public record when he acquired the house.

Q86803 A man owned land along the south side of a highway. To the south of the man's land was a lot owned by a woman who lived on it in a house.

Five years ago, the man conveyed a right-of-way easement over his land to the woman because it provided a more direct route between her house and the highway. The easement was evidenced by a clearly marked path. The document granting the easement was promptly recorded.

Three years ago, the woman conveyed the house to the man. The man never took actual possession of the house.

Two years ago, the man conveyed the house to a purchaser by a warranty deed. Two months after the purchaser moved into the house, a neighbor informed him about the easement. He then began using the path that had been marked on the man's land. When the man noticed the purchaser using the path, he erected a barricade on his land that effectively prevented the purchaser from using the path.

The purchaser has sued the man, claiming that he has an easement over the man's land.

Who is likely to prevail? 一名男子在一条公路南侧拥有一块土地。该男子土地的南边是一块地，地上一栋房屋为一名女子所有并由其居住。

五年前，该男子向该女子转让了其土地上的一项通行地役权，因为这为她的房屋和公路之间提供了一条更直接的路线。该地役权由一条清晰标记的小路证明。授予地役权的文件被及时登记。

三年前，该女子将房屋转让给了该男子。该男子从未实际占有该房屋。

两年前，该男子通过一份担保契约将房屋转让给了一位买方。买方搬入该房屋两个月后，一位邻居告知了他关于该地役权的事。于是他开始使用该男子土地上标记的小路。当该男子注意到买方在使用小路时，他在自己的土地上设置了一个路障，有效地阻止了买方使用该小路。

买方已起诉该男子，声称其对该男子的土地拥有地役权。

谁可能胜诉？
options:
A. The man, because the easement was extinguished.
男子，因为地役权已经消灭。

B. The man, because the purchaser did not have actual notice of the easement at the time of acquisition.
男子，因为买方在获得所有权时并未实际知晓该地役权的存在。

C. The purchaser, because he purchased the house by warranty deed.
买方，因为他是通过担保契约购买的房屋。

D. The purchaser, because the easement was of public record when he acquired the house.
买方，因为在他获得房屋所有权时，该地役权已有公共记录。
data.explanation:
Ways to terminate easements

Destruction – servient estate condemned or destroyed by natural forces
Abandonment - dominant estate abandons easement
Merger - dominant & servient estates united in common ownership
Prescription - servient owner prevents use for prescriptive period
Estoppel - dominant owner estopped from asserting easement
Release - express release in writing satisfying statute of frauds
Mnemonic: DAMPER

An easement is extinguished by merger when the dominant estate (ie, land benefited by the easement) and the servient estate (ie, land burdened by the easement) are united in common ownership. Once extinguished, the easement is not revived simply because the land is re-severed into two parcels. Instead, a new easement must be created.

Here, the man conveyed an easement to the woman that allowed her to cross his land to access the highway. The easement was extinguished when the dominant estate (woman's lot) and servient estate (man's land) merged into the hands of one owner after the woman conveyed her house to the man. And it was not revived when the man re-severed the land by conveying the house to the purchaser—regardless of the purchaser's actual or record notice of the prior easement (Choices B & D). Therefore, the purchaser has no easement over the man's land.

(Choice C) The fact that the purchaser acquired the house by warranty deed has no impact on whether the prior easement terminated (or was then revived). But if the man had purported to convey an easement over his land to the purchaser, then the purchaser could have sued the man for breach of warranties under the deed.

Educational objective: Under the merger doctrine, an easement is terminated if the dominant and servient estates are united in common ownership. The terminated easement is not revived by re-severing the land into two parcels.

终止地役权的方式

毁损 – 供役地被征用或因自然力被毁坏
放弃 - 需役地所有权人放弃地役权
合并 - 需役地和供役地归于同一人所有
时效 - 供役地所有权人阻止使用达到法定时效期间
禁止反言 - 需役地所有权人因禁止反言不得主张地役权
解除 - 满足反欺诈法的书面明示解除
助记词：DAMPER

当地役权中的需役地（即受益于地役权的土地）和供役地（即受地役权负担的土地）归于同一人所有时，地役权将因合并而消灭。一旦消灭，地役权不会因为土地重新分割为两块而自动恢复。相反，必须重新设立一项新的地役权。

在本案中，该男子向女子转让了一项地役权，允许她穿越他的土地以通往公路。当女子将她的房屋转让给该男子后，需役地（女子的地块）和供役地（男子的土地）合并到同一所有权人手中，地役权因此消灭。并且，在该男子通过将房屋转让给买方而重新分割土地时，该地役权并未恢复——无论买方对先前的地役权是否有实际或登记上的知晓（选项B和D）。因此，买方对该男子的土地不拥有地役权。

(选项C) 买方通过担保契约获得房屋所有权这一事实，对于先前的地役权是否终止（或此后是否恢复）没有影响。但是，如果该男子声称向买方转让了其土地上的地役权，那么买方可以依据契约中的担保条款起诉该男子违约。

教学目的： 根据合并原则，如果需役地和供役地归于同一人所有，地役权即告终止。已终止的地役权不会因将土地重新分割为两块而恢复。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 7.5 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (termination by merger).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Easements (地役权)
核心考点：混同原则 (Merger Doctrine)

当地役权中的需役地 (Dominant Estate) 和供役地 (Servient Estate) 的所有权归属于同一人 (Common Ownership) 时，地役权自动消灭。

关键规则：一旦因混同而消灭，地役权不会因为土地再次被分割或转让而自动恢复 (Revive)。

阶段 1：设立 (Creation)
男子拥有土地 (供役地)，女子拥有房屋 (需役地)。
地役权有效存在。
阶段 2：混同 (Merger)
女子将房屋转让给男子。
男子现在同时拥有供役地和需役地。
结果：地役权消灭 (Extinguished)。
注：男子是否实际居住不影响所有权的统一。
Lot A
Lot B
➔
Owner: Man
(Merged)
阶段 3：转让 (Conveyance)
男子将房屋卖给买方 (Purchaser)。
虽然土地再次被分割，但之前的地役权已经死亡，不会自动复活。
为什么选 A？

A. The man, because the easement was extinguished.

这是对混同原则的直接应用。当男子获得房屋所有权时，地役权因混同而永久消灭。买方购买房屋时，并没有获得任何有效的地役权，除非重新设立（本题事实未显示重新设立）。

选项 B 错误
Notice (知情) 无关紧要。 买方是否知情 (Actual Notice) 只有在地役权仍然存在时才讨论。既然地役权已经消灭，知情与否不改变结果。

选项 C 错误
Warranty Deed (担保契约) 不能复活地役权。 担保契约保证的是产权的质量，它不会自动创造或恢复一个已经消灭的第三方权利。

选项 D 错误
Record (登记) 不能拯救已消灭的权利。 虽然地役权文件还在公共记录中，但法律上的混同事件已经使其失效。过期的记录不产生法律效力。

💡 MBE 解题技巧

在做地役权题目时，如果看到"Dominant owner buys servient land" 或 "Servient owner buys dominant land"（即两块地归同一人），脑海中要立刻闪现单词：MERGER (混同)。

记住口诀："You cannot have an easement over your own land." (你不能在自己的土地上拥有地役权)。

questions.question:
In a written and signed agreement, a woman, for a fee, granted her neighbor the right to access his property by way of a driveway he was to construct across her property. The neighbor, who could access his property via other reasonable means, had sought the access right because it was more convenient. The neighbor did not record the agreement. Due to financial concerns, the neighbor did not construct the driveway, but he intended to do so in the future.
Six months later, the woman sold her property to a buyer. The buyer did not record her deed from the woman. The buyer had no knowledge of the neighbor's right of access across the property she had purchased.
Yesterday, a year after the sale, the neighbor informed the buyer that he plans to construct the driveway next week.
The jurisdiction has a notice recording act.
If the buyer sues to prevent the neighbor from constructing the driveway, will the buyer be successful?

choices.a: No, because the buyer failed to record her deed from the woman.
choices.b: No, because the neighbor's agreement with the woman created an express easement, which cannot be terminated by mere nonuse.
choices.c: Yes, because the buyer lacked notice of the neighbor's right to construct a driveway on her property.
choices.d: Yes, because the neighbor failed to construct the driveway on the property before the woman sold the property.

In a written and signed agreement, a woman, for a fee, granted her neighbor the right to access his property by way of a driveway he was to construct across her property. The neighbor, who could access his property via other reasonable means, had sought the access right because it was more convenient. The neighbor did not record the agreement. Due to financial concerns, the neighbor did not construct the driveway, but he intended to do so in the future.

Six months later, the woman sold her property to a buyer. The buyer did not record her deed from the woman. The buyer had no knowledge of the neighbor's right of access across the property she had purchased.

Yesterday, a year after the sale, the neighbor informed the buyer that he plans to construct the driveway next week.

The jurisdiction has a notice recording act.

If the buyer sues to prevent the neighbor from constructing the driveway, will the buyer be successful?

在一份书面签署的协议中，一名女子在收取费用后，授予其邻居一项权利，邻居可以通过其将在女子地产上修建的一条车道进入其自己的地产。该邻居本可以通过其他合理方式进入其地产，但他为了更方便而寻求此通行权。邻居并未登记该协议。由于财务问题，邻居没有修建车道，但他打算将来再修建。

六个月后，该女子将其地产出售给一名买方。买方没有登记她从该女子处获得的契约。买方对邻居在她所购地产上拥有的通行权毫不知情。

昨天，即交易一年后，邻居通知买方，他计划下周修建车道。

该司法管辖区实行通知登记法(notice recording act)。

如果买方提起诉讼，要求阻止邻居修建车道，买方会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the buyer failed to record her deed from the woman.
不会，因为买方未能登记她从女子处获得的契约。

B. No, because the neighbor's agreement with the woman created an express easement, which cannot be terminated by mere nonuse.
不会，因为邻居与女子的协议设立了一项明示地役权(express easement)，该权利不能仅因不使用而被终止。

C. Yes, because the buyer lacked notice of the neighbor's right to construct a driveway on her property.
会，因为买方对邻居有权在其地产上修建车道一事不知情。

D. Yes, because the neighbor failed to construct the driveway on the property before the woman sold the property.
会，因为邻居在该女子出售地产前未能修建车道。
data.explanation:
Types of recording acts


TypeEffectStatutory language
RaceInterest holder who records first will prevail"First record"
NoticeSubsequent BFP without notice of earlier property interest will prevail"Without notice," "In good faith"
Race-NoticeSubsequent BFP (1) without notice of earlier property interest (2) who records first will prevail"Without notice, who shall first record"
BFP = Bona fide purchaser.

An easement is a nonpossessory interest in real property that gives the easement holder the right to use another's land for a specific, limited purpose - eg, the neighbor's right to construct a driveway across her property. As real property interests, easements are subject to the jurisdiction's recording act. Under a notice recording act (as seen here), a real property interest cannot be enforced against a subsequent purchaser of a conflicting real property interest who lacks notice (actual, record, or inquiry) of the prior interest.

Here, the buyer had no knowledge of the neighbor's easement when she purchased the property (no actual notice). Additionally, the neighbor had neither recorded the agreement in which the woman granted him the easement (no record notice) nor constructed the driveway (no inquiry notice) at that time. Therefore, the neighbor cannot enforce his easement against the buyer, and she can prevent him from constructing a driveway across her property.

(Choice A) A purchaser who is protected by a recording act (eg, the buyer) does not have to record his/her property interest to enjoy the act's protection from a person who had previously acquired a conflicting interest in the same property (eg, the neighbor).

(Choice B) An easement is terminated by abandonment if the easement holder acts in an affirmative way that shows a clear intent to relinquish the easement right - mere nonuse is insufficient. Therefore, the neighbor's express easement was not terminated by his mere failure to construct the driveway. But that easement is unenforceable because the buyer is protected by the notice recording act.

(Choice D) The neighbor's failure to construct a driveway on the property before the woman sold it helps show that the buyer lacked inquiry notice of the neighbor's easement. But the buyer will only be successful because she also lacked actual and record notice.

Educational objective: Under a notice recording act, a real property interest (eg, easement) cannot be enforced against a subsequent purchaser of a conflicting real property interest (eg, the land subject to the easement) who lacks notice of the prior interest.

选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 19%，C选项 68%（正确选项），D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

登记法案的类型


类型效果法条措辞
Race (竞争登记制)首先登记的权益持有人将获胜“首先登记” (“First record”)
Notice (通知登记制)对先前地产权益不知情的后续善意购买人将获胜“不知情” (“Without notice”)，“善意” (“In good faith”)
Race-Notice (竞争-通知登记制)后续的善意购买人(1)对先前的地产权益不知情且(2)首先登记的，将获胜“不知情，且首先登记” (“Without notice, who shall first record”)
BFP = 善意购买人 (Bona fide purchaser)。

地役权 (easement) 是一种地产上的非占有性权益，它赋予地役权持有人为特定、有限的目的使用他人土地的权利——例如，邻居横跨她地产修建车道的权利。作为地产权益，地役权受司法管辖区的登记法案约束。根据通知登记法 (notice recording act)（如本案所示），一项地产权益不能对一名购买了冲突地产权益的后续购买人强制执行，如果该购买人对先前的权益不知悉（包括实际通知、登记通知或查询通知）。

在本案中，买方在购买地产时对邻居的地役权一无所知（无实际通知）。此外，当时邻居既没有登记女子授予他地役权的协议（无登记通知），也没有修建车道（无查询通知）。因此，邻居不能对买方强制执行其地役权，买方可以阻止他在其地产上修建车道。

(选项A) 受登记法案保护的购买人（如本案买方）无需登记其地产权益，即可享有该法案提供的保护，以对抗先前在同一地产上取得冲突权益的人（如本案邻居）。

(选项B) 如果地役权持有人以积极行为表明其明确放弃地役权的意图，则该地役权因放弃而终止——仅仅不使用是不够的。因此，邻居的明示地役权并未因他仅仅未能修建车道而终止。但该地役权是不可强制执行的，因为买方受到通知登记法的保护。

(选项D) 邻居在女子出售地产前未能修建车道，这有助于表明买方对邻居的地役权缺乏查询通知。但买方之所以能胜诉，是因为她同时也缺乏实际通知和登记通知。

教学目标：根据通知登记法，一项地产权益（如地役权）不能对购买了冲突地产权益（如负有地役权的土地）且对先前权益不知情的后续购买人强制执行。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property § 7.14 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (extinguishment of servitude benefits under recording act).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Recording Acts
核心考点：通知登记法 (Notice Recording Act)

在实行“通知登记法”的司法管辖区，如果后续的善意购买人 (Bona Fide Purchaser, BFP) 在购买时对先前的地产权益不知情 (Without Notice)，则该后续购买人胜诉。

关键原则：最后的善意购买人获胜 (The last BFP wins)。

案情逻辑推演

1
先前权益 (Prior Interest)：
邻居获得了一项明示地役权 (Express Easement)。但他没有登记 (Did not record)，也没有修建车道。
2
后续交易 (Subsequent Transaction)：
买方购买了该地产。此时，买方属于有偿购买人 (Purchaser for value)。
3
通知分析 (Notice Analysis)：
买方是否知情？
  • 实际通知 (Actual Notice)： 无。题目明确说明买方不知情。
  • 登记通知 (Record Notice)： 无。邻居未登记协议。
  • 查询通知 (Inquiry Notice)： 无。车道尚未修建，实地考察看不出异常。
4
法律适用 (Application)：
因为是Notice Jurisdiction，且买方是BFP without notice，所以买方的权益优于邻居未登记的地役权。
✅ 正确答案：C

会胜诉，因为买方对邻居有权在其地产上修建车道一事不知情。

根据通知登记法，未登记的地役权对随后的善意购买人（BFP）无效，除非该购买人知情。由于买方缺乏所有形式的通知（实际、推定或查询），她受到登记法的保护，可以阻止邻居行使地役权。

❌ 选项 A (买方未登记)： 这是一个常见的陷阱。在Notice Act下，后续BFP不需要比前手先登记就能获胜，只要她在购买时不知情即可。（只有在 Race-Notice 管辖区，后续BFP才必须“先登记”才能获胜）。

❌ 选项 B (地役权未终止)： 法律陈述本身是正确的（单纯不使用不能终止地役权），但这与本案无关。问题不在于地役权是否因放弃而消灭，而在于它是否能对抗受登记法保护的BFP。地役权虽然在邻居和原房主之间有效，但对不知情的买方不可强制执行 (Unenforceable)。

❌ 选项 D (未修建车道)： 这是一个事实陈述，它支持了“无查询通知”的论点，但不是买方胜诉的完整法律依据。胜诉的根本原因是缺乏所有类型的通知（包括登记通知和实际通知）。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到 Recording Act 题目，首先看最后一句或事实部分确定的法案类型：
  • Notice: "without notice" (不知情者赢)
  • Race-Notice: "without notice... first recorded" (不知情且先登记者赢)
  • Race: "first recorded" (手快者赢，不管知不知情)
本题明确说是 Notice Act，因此只需判断买方是否知情，无需考虑买方是否登记。

questions.question:
A woman owned a house on a lot abutting a public street. Six months ago, the city validly revised its zoning ordinances and placed the woman's lot and the surrounding lots abutting the public street from the north in a zone limited to residential use; the lots abutting the public street on the south side were zoned for both residential and light business use.
The woman asked the city's zoning appeals board to approve her proposal to operate a court-reporting service from her house. This type of use would be permitted on the south side of the public street and, in fact, one such business has existed there for several years.
The board approved the woman's proposal. Why?

choices.a: A variance was granted.
choices.b: The doctrine of amortization applied.
choices.c: The doctrine of change of circumstances applied.
choices.d: The woman's use of her house was a nonconforming use.

data.questionStem:
Q86149

A woman owned a house on a lot abutting a public street. Six months ago, the city validly revised its zoning ordinances and placed the woman's lot and the surrounding lots abutting the public street from the north in a zone limited to residential use; the lots abutting the public street on the south side were zoned for both residential and light business use.

The woman asked the city's zoning appeals board to approve her proposal to operate a court-reporting service from her house. This type of use would be permitted on the south side of the public street and, in fact, one such business has existed there for several years.

The board approved the woman's proposal. Why?

一名女子拥有一所房子，其地块毗邻一条公共街道。六个月前，该市有效地修订了其区划条例，将该女子地块及北侧毗邻公共街道的周边地块划入仅限住宅用途的区域；而南侧毗邻公共街道的地块则被划为住宅和轻型商业两用区。

该女子请求市区的区划上诉委员会批准她在家中经营庭审记录服务的提议。这种用途在公共街道的南侧是被允许的，事实上，那里已经有一家此类企业经营了数年。

委员会批准了该女子的提议。为什么？
options:
A. A variance was granted.
授予了一项用途特许(variance)。

B. The doctrine of amortization applied.
适用了摊销原则。

C. The doctrine of change of circumstances applied.
适用了情势变更原则。

D. The woman's use of her house was a nonconforming use.
该女子对其房屋的使用属于不合规定用途。
data.explanation:
A variance is created when a local government (often a zoning board) gives a landowner permission to deviate from a zoning requirement. There are two types of variances:
  • use variances - allow land to be used differently than the currently zoned use (eg, commercial use in residential area) and
  • area variances - allow structures on the land to look different than structures on the rest of the zoned area (eg, height, lot size, building placement).


Variances are often granted if the landowner can show that (1) enforcement of a zoning requirement would cause the landowner unnecessary hardship † regarding the use of the land and (2) the variance would not be contrary to public interest (eg, public safety, comprehensive planning).

Here, the revised ordinance placed the woman's house in a zone limited to residential use. The enforcement of this ordinance would cause hardship to the woman's use of the land by preventing the operation of a court-reporting service from her house. This hardship would be unnecessary, and a variance would have little impact on public interest, because light business use is permitted across the street. As a result, the board likely approved the woman's proposal by granting a variance.

† Courts often reject landowners' claims of unnecessary hardship when the hardship is self-imposed or the landowner can still make use of the property without a variance.

(Choices B & D) The doctrine of amortization applies to a nonconforming use - ie, one that lawfully existed before but is now prohibited by a zoning law. Since the woman's court-reporting service does not yet exist, this doctrine does not apply. But even if it did, it would allow the government to terminate (not approve) a nonconforming use after a reasonable time that allows a landowner to gradually phase out or recoup an investment in that use.

(Choice C) The doctrine of changed circumstances (ie, changed conditions) terminates or prevents the enforcement of a real covenant or equitable servitude that no longer provides its intended benefit - but it does not apply to zoning ordinances.

Educational objective: Variances are often granted if (1) enforcement of a zoning requirement would cause the landowner unnecessary hardship regarding the use of the land and (2) a variance would not be contrary to a public interest.



选项正确率统计：A选项 87%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 3%，D选项 6%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当地方政府（通常是区划委员会）给予土地所有者偏离某项区划规定的许可时，就产生了一项用途特许 (variance)。用途特许有两种类型：
  • 使用用途特许 (use variances) - 允许土地的使用方式与当前区划规定的用途不同（例如，在住宅区进行商业使用）以及
  • 面积用途特许 (area variances) - 允许土地上的建筑物的外观与区划区域内其他建筑物不同（例如，高度、地块大小、建筑物位置）。


如果土地所有者能够证明（1）执行区划规定将给土地所有者在使用土地方面造成不必要的困难 (unnecessary hardship)†，并且（2）该用途特许不会违背公共利益（例如，公共安全、综合规划），那么用途特许通常会被授予。

在本案中，修订后的条例将该女子的房屋划入仅限住宅用途的区域。执行该条例将阻止她在家中经营庭审记录服务，从而给该女子使用土地带来困难。这种困难是不必要的，而且由于街道对面允许轻型商业用途，因此一项用途特许对公共利益影响甚微。因此，委员会很可能是通过授予一项用途特许来批准该女子的提议的。

† 当困难是土地所有者自己造成，或者在没有用途特许的情况下土地所有者仍能使用其财产时，法院通常会驳回土地所有者关于不必要困难的主张。

（选项B和D）摊销原则适用于不合规定用途 (nonconforming use)——即在区划法颁布前合法存在，但现在被禁止的用途。由于该女子的庭审记录服务尚不存在，因此该原则不适用。但即使适用，它也允许政府在给予土地所有者一段合理时间以逐步淘汰或收回对该用途的投资后，终止（而非批准）不合规定用途。

（选项C）情势变更原则（即条件变更）会终止或阻止执行不再能提供其预期利益的土地物权契约 (real covenant) 或衡平法地役权 (equitable servitude)，但它不适用于区划条例。

教学目标：如果（1）执行区划规定将给土地所有者在使用土地方面造成不必要的困难，并且（2）一项用途特许不会违背公共利益，那么用途特许通常会被授予。

References

  • 83 Am. Jur. 2d Zoning & Planning §§ 706 - 93 (2019) (providing an overview on variances).
  • E & F Assocs., LLC v. Zoning Bd. of Appeals, 127 A.3d 986, 990 (Conn. 2015) (defining variance and identifying considerations in granting a variance).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Zoning
正确答案：A 授予了一项用途特许 (Variance)。

本题考察的核心是区划法 (Zoning Law) 中，当业主的土地使用计划与现行法规冲突时，行政机关如何进行救济。

核心概念：用途特许 (Variance)

定义：Variance 是行政机关（通常是 Zoning Board）给予业主的许可，允许其背离现行的区划条例。

分类：

  • Use Variance (使用特许)：允许进行被禁止的用途（如本题：在住宅区进行商业活动）。
  • Area Variance (面积特许)：允许建筑规格违规（如高度、退红线距离）。

通常授予的条件：

  1. 不必要的困难 (Unnecessary Hardship)：严格执行法规会给业主造成独特的困难。
  2. 不违背公共利益 (Public Interest)：特许不会改变社区的基本特征或损害公众福利。
本案逻辑分析
➤
现状冲突：该女子的房子被划入“仅限住宅区”(Residential Use Only)，但她想经营庭审记录服务（商业用途）。这违反了现行条例。
➤
委员会的行为：委员会批准了她的请求。在法律上，这种“允许背离规定”的行政行为就是授予 Variance。
➤
理由支持：街道对面已经是混合商业区，且已有类似企业。因此，批准她的申请不会损害社区特征（符合 Public Interest），且严格禁止可能对她构成不必要的限制。
为什么其他选项是错误的？
不合规定用途 (Nonconforming Use)：
Nonconforming use 指的是在区划法变更之前就已经存在的合法用途。本案中，该女子是在法规变更之后才提议开展业务的，因此不属于此类。
摊销原则 (Amortization)：
这是政府用来逐步终止不合规定用途的手段（给业主一段时间回本，然后必须关停）。本案是批准新业务，而非关闭旧业务。
情势变更 (Change of Circumstances)：
这是一个物权法 (Property Law) 中关于私人契约 (Covenants/Servitudes) 的抗辩理由，用于解除私人土地负担。它不适用于公法性质的区划条例 (Zoning Ordinances)。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
在做 Zoning 题目时，首先判断时间线：
  • 如果是先有用途，后有法规 ➔ 考虑 Nonconforming Use。
  • 如果是先有法规，后想违规使用 ➔ 考虑 Variance（特许）或 Rezoning（重新区划）。
此外，注意区分公法（Zoning）和私法（Covenants）的术语，不要混用。

questions.question:
A man owned in fee simple a lot in a properly approved subdivision, designed and zoned for industrial use. His friend owned the adjoining lot in the same subdivision. The plat of the subdivision was recorded as authorized by statute.
Twelve years ago, the man erected an industrial building wholly situated on his lot but with one wall along the boundary common with the friend's lot. The construction was done as authorized by a building permit that was validly obtained under applicable statutes, ordinances, and regulations. Further, the construction was regularly inspected and found in compliance with all building code requirements.
The friend's lot remained vacant until six months ago, when she began excavation pursuant to a building permit authorizing the erection of an industrial building situated on her lot but with one wall along the boundary common with the man's lot. The excavation caused subsidence of a portion of the man's lot that resulted in injury to his building. The excavation was not done negligently or with any malicious intent to injure.
In the jurisdiction, the time to acquire title by adverse possession or rights by prescription is 10 years.
The man has brought an appropriate action against the friend to recover damages resulting from the injuries to the building on his lot.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.a: The friend, because both lots are urban land, as distinguished from rural land, so the man had the duty to protect any improvements on his lot.
choices.b: The friend, because the construction and use of her building were authorized by the applicable law.
choices.c: The man, because a right for support, appurtenant to his lot, had been acquired by adverse possession or prescription.
choices.d: The man, if the subsidence would have occurred without the weight of the building on his lot.

data.questionStem:
Q86195

A man owned in fee simple a lot in a properly approved subdivision, designed and zoned for industrial use. His friend owned the adjoining lot in the same subdivision. The plat of the subdivision was recorded as authorized by statute.

Twelve years ago, the man erected an industrial building wholly situated on his lot but with one wall along the boundary common with the friend's lot. The construction was done as authorized by a building permit that was validly obtained under applicable statutes, ordinances, and regulations. Further, the construction was regularly inspected and found in compliance with all building code requirements.

The friend's lot remained vacant until six months ago, when she began excavation pursuant to a building permit authorizing the erection of an industrial building situated on her lot but with one wall along the boundary common with the man's lot. The excavation caused subsidence of a portion of the man's lot that resulted in injury to his building. The excavation was not done negligently or with any malicious intent to injure.

In the jurisdiction, the time to acquire title by adverse possession or rights by prescription is 10 years.

The man has brought an appropriate action against the friend to recover damages resulting from the injuries to the building on his lot.

Who is likely to prevail?

一名男子以完全所有权（fee simple）拥有一块位于经合法批准的、为工业用途设计和规划的细分地块。他的朋友拥有同一细分地块中的相邻地块。该细分地块的规划图已根据法规授权进行了登记。

十二年前，该男子在他的地块上建造了一座工业建筑，建筑完全位于其地块内，但有一堵墙紧邻与朋友地块的共同边界。该建筑的施工获得了根据适用法规、条例和规章有效取得的建筑许可的授权。此外，该建筑经过定期检查，被认定符合所有建筑规范要求。

朋友的地块一直空置，直到六个月前，她根据一份建筑许可开始挖掘。该许可授权其在地块上建造一座工业建筑，同样有一堵墙紧邻与男子地块的共同边界。该挖掘导致男子地块的一部分下沉，从而对其建筑造成了损害。该挖掘并非出于过失或任何恶意伤害的意图。

在该司法管辖区，通过侵权逆占（adverse possession）或时效取得（prescription）获得所有权或权利的时效为10年。

该男子已对朋友提起适当的诉讼，要求赔偿其地块上建筑所受的损害。

谁可能胜诉？
options:
A. The friend, because both lots are urban land, as distinguished from rural land, so the man had the duty to protect any improvements on his lot.
朋友，因为两块地块均为城市土地，而非乡村土地，因此男子有责任保护其地块上的任何改良物。

B. The friend, because the construction and use of her building were authorized by the applicable law.
朋友，因为她的建筑的施工和使用得到了适用法律的授权。

C. The man, because a right for support, appurtenant to his lot, had been acquired by adverse possession or prescription.
男子，因为其地块的附属支撑权已通过侵权逆占（adverse possession）或时效取得（prescription）获得。

D. The man, if the subsidence would have occurred without the weight of the building on his lot.
男子，如果即使没有其地块上建筑的重量，地面下沉仍然会发生。
data.explanation:
Withdrawal of lateral & subjacent support


Natural stateImproved
LateralStrictly liable for damage to adjacent land caused by subsidenceIf damage to land & improvements would have occurred in land's natural state, strictly liable If not, liable if negligent
Subjacent
Landowners have a right to lateral support from all adjoining land. Therefore, an adjoining landowner who withdraws lateral support for land in a natural state is strictly liable for any subsidence (ie, cave-in, slippage) that occurs because of that withdrawal. But if the adjoining landowner withdraws lateral support for improved land - as seen with the man's industrial building - the adjoining landowner may be:
  • strictly liable if the landowner can show that damage to the land and improvements would have occurred in the land's natural state or
  • liable for negligence if the landowner cannot make such a showing.


Here, the friend's excavation was not done negligently or with any malicious intent to injure the man. This means that the man can only recover damages resulting from the injuries to his improved land if the friend is subject to strict liability. And if the man shows that the subsidence would have occurred without the weight of the building on his lot, he will likely prevail.

(Choice A) A possessor of land in an urban area has a duty to exercise reasonable care to prevent an unreasonable risk of harm arising from conditions on his/her land. Here, there is no evidence that the man (or the friend) breached this duty, so this principle would not affect the outcome of the lawsuit.

(Choice B) The fact that the construction and use of the friend's building were authorized by law helps show that the friend was not negligent, but it does not shield her from strict liability since it is imposed regardless of fault.

(Choice C) A landowner cannot acquire a right to lateral support by adverse possession or prescription. That is because there is no actual possession or use of the adjoining land to satisfy the elements of those claims.

Educational objective: An adjoining landowner who withdraws lateral support for improved land is (1) strictly liable if the landowner can show that damage to the land and improvements would have occurred in the land's natural state or (2) liable for negligence if no such showing is made.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 6%，C选项 26%，D选项 64%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

侧向与下层支撑的撤除


自然状态有改良物
侧向支撑对因下沉造成的相邻土地损害承担严格责任如果土地和改良物的损害在土地处于自然状态时也会发生，则承担严格责任。如果不会，则在有过失时承担责任。
下层支撑
土地所有者有权获得所有相邻土地的侧向支撑。因此，撤除处于自然状态土地的侧向支撑的相邻土地所有者，对因此撤除而发生的任何下沉（即塌陷、滑坡）承担严格责任。但是，如果相邻土地所有者撤除的是有改良物土地的侧向支撑——如本案中男子的工业建筑所在土地——则该相邻土地所有者可能：
  • 承担严格责任，如果土地所有者能证明，即使土地处于自然状态，对土地和改良物的损害本就会发生；或者
  • 如果土地所有者不能做出此类证明，则因过失承担责任。


在本案中，朋友的挖掘并非出于过失或任何恶意伤害该男子的意图。这意味着，只有在朋友须承担严格责任的情况下，该男子才能就其有改良物土地所受损害获得赔偿。并且，如果该男子能证明，即使没有其地块上建筑的重量，地面下沉仍然会发生，那么他很可能胜诉。

(选项A) 城市区域的土地占有人有责任采取合理注意，以防止因其土地上的状况而产生不合理的损害风险。在本案中，没有证据表明男子（或朋友）违反了此责任，因此该原则不会影响诉讼结果。

(选项B) 朋友的建筑施工和使用得到法律授权这一事实，有助于证明朋友没有过失，但这并不能使她免于严格责任，因为严格责任的施加不考虑过错。

(选项C) 土地所有者不能通过侵权逆占（adverse possession）或时效取得（prescription）来获得侧向支撑权。这是因为并没有对相邻土地的实际占有或使用来满足这些权利主张的构成要件。

教学目标：撤除有改良物土地的侧向支撑的相邻土地所有者，在以下情况承担责任：（1）如果土地所有者能证明，即使土地处于自然状态，对土地和改良物的损害本就会发生，则承担严格责任；或（2）如果无法做出此类证明，则因过失承担责任。

References

Restatement (Second) of Torts §§ 817 - 18 (Am. Law Inst. 1979) (withdrawal of lateral support).

data.htmlContent:
侧向支撑权

Lateral Support Rights
⚖️ 核心法律规则

土地所有者有权要求相邻土地提供侧向支撑 (Lateral Support)。责任判定取决于土地是处于“自然状态”还是有“人工改良物”。

责任判定逻辑表
土地状态
责任类型
条件
自然状态
(Natural State)
严格责任
(Strict Liability)
只要挖掘导致下沉即负责
有改良物
(Improved Land)
过失责任
(Negligence)
需证明挖掘者有过失
本案关键事实分析

题目中明确指出：朋友的挖掘行为“没有过失 (not done negligently)”。

这意味着男子不能基于过失侵权（Negligence）索赔。他唯一的胜诉机会是证明朋友应当承担严格责任 (Strict Liability)。

改良物上的严格责任例外

虽然一般规则是对改良物（如建筑物）的损害只承担过失责任，但有一个重要的例外：

如果原告能证明，即使没有建筑物的重量，土地依然会下沉（即土地在自然状态下也会塌陷），那么被告对土地和建筑物都要承担严格责任。

✅ 选项 D 正确

理由：选项 D 准确描述了上述例外情况。如果男子能证明“即使没有建筑物的重量，下沉仍会发生”，说明挖掘行为极其严重，破坏了土地本身的自然支撑力。在这种情况下，严格责任延伸至土地上的建筑物。

陷阱选项排除
❌ 选项 A (Urban Land)：
法律规则不区分城市或乡村土地。侧向支撑权是普通法下的基本财产权利，不因地理位置而改变。
❌ 选项 B (Authorized by Law)：
获得建筑许可（Permit）只能证明没有“违反法规的过失 (Negligence per se)”，但不能豁免严格责任。如果行为触发了严格责任，是否合法合规并不重要。
❌ 选项 C (Adverse Possession)：
这是一个常见的 MBE 陷阱。侧向支撑权不能通过时效取得 (Prescription) 获得。
原因：时效取得要求权利主张是“显而易见且敌对的 (Open and Notorious)”。邻居建房并没有侵犯你的权利，你没有理由去起诉他，因此时效期从未开始计算。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

看到“挖掘 (Excavation)”导致邻居房屋受损的题目：

  1. 首先看是否有过失 (Negligence)。如果有，直接选原告胜诉。
  2. 如果没有过失，看是否满足“自然状态测试 (Natural State Test)”。即：把房子拿走，地会不会塌？
    • 会塌 ➡️ 严格责任（赔地+赔房）。
    • 不会塌（是因为房子太重才塌的）➡️ 被告无责。

questions.question:
A tenant leased a commercial property from a landlord for a 12-year term. The property included a large store and a parking lot. At the start of the lease period, the tenant took possession and with the landlord's oral consent installed counters, display cases, removable shelving, and special lighting. Both parties complied with all lease terms.
The lease is set to expire next month. Two weeks ago, when the landlord contacted the tenant about a possible lease renewal, she learned that the tenant had decided not to renew the lease and planned to remove all of the above-listed items on or before the lease termination date. The landlord claimed that all the items had become part of the real estate and had to remain on the premises. The tenant asserted his right and intention to remove all the items.
Both the lease and the statutes of the jurisdiction are silent on the matter in dispute. At the time the landlord consented and the tenant installed the items, nothing was said about the tenant's right to retain or remove the items.
The landlord has sued the tenant to enjoin his removal of the items. How is the court likely to rule?

choices.a: For the landlord as to items bolted or otherwise attached to the premises, and for the tenant as to items not attached to the premises other than by weight.
choices.b: For the landlord, because the items have become part of the landlord's real estate.
choices.c: For the tenant, because all of the items may be removed as trade fixtures without any obligation to restore the premises.
choices.d: For the tenant, provided that the tenant reasonably restores the premises to the prior condition or pays for the cost of restoration.

一名租户向房东租赁了一处商业地产，租期为12年。该地产包括一个大商铺和一个停车场。租赁期开始时，租户占有该地产，并在房东的口头同意下，安装了柜台、陈列柜、可移动货架和特殊照明设备。双方均遵守了所有租赁条款。

租赁合同将于下月到期。两周前，当房东联系租户商讨续租可能性时，她得知租户已决定不续租，并计划在租赁终止日或之前拆除所有上述物品。房东主张，所有这些物品已成为房地产的一部分，必须保留在该物业中。租户则声称其有权并意图拆除所有物品。

租赁合同和该司法管辖区的法规对争议事项均未作规定。在房东同意且租户安装这些物品时，双方并未就租户保留或拆除这些物品的权利进行任何约定。

房东已起诉租户，请求法院发布禁令，禁止其拆除这些物品。法院可能会如何裁决？
options:
A. For the landlord as to items bolted or otherwise attached to the premises, and for the tenant as to items not attached to the premises other than by weight.
支持房东，针对以螺栓固定或以其他方式附着于物业的物品；支持租户，针对除因自身重量外未附着于物业的物品。

B. For the landlord, because the items have become part of the landlord's real estate.
支持房东，因为这些物品已成为房东房地产的一部分。

C. For the tenant, because all of the items may be removed as trade fixtures without any obligation to restore the premises.
支持租户，因为所有物品都可以作为营业附加物被拆除，且没有义务恢复物业原状。

D. For the tenant, provided that the tenant reasonably restores the premises to the prior condition or pays for the cost of restoration.
支持租户，前提是租户将物业合理地恢复到先前的状态，或支付恢复费用。
data.explanation:
A tenant cannot remove fixtures - ie, items so connected with (or attached to) real property that they are considered a part of that property - without the landlord's consent. However, a tenant can remove trade fixtures - ie, items attached to real property by the tenant for use in his/her trade or business - without the landlord's consent if:
  • the items are removed before, or within a reasonable time after, the lease terminates and
  • the removal will not substantially harm the property (eg, will not degrade the building's structural integrity).
But after the removal, the tenant must reasonably restore the property to its prior condition or pay restoration costs.

Here, the counters, display cases, removable shelving, and special lighting are trade fixtures since the tenant installed them for use in the store and parking lot that he leased from the landlord. Since there is no evidence that removing these items will substantially harm the property and the lease will not expire until next month, the tenant can remove them. However, he must reasonably restore the premises to its prior condition or pay restoration costs (Choice C).

(Choice A) Although some of the tenant's trade fixtures may be bolted or otherwise attached to the premises, there is no evidence that removing them will substantially harm the property. Therefore, the court will likely allow the tenant to remove all of these items regardless of how they were attached.

(Choice B) Fixtures are considered part of the landlord's property (ie, real estate), but trade fixtures are not. Instead, the tenant retains ownership of the trade fixtures and can remove them from the landlord's property if the above conditions are met.

Educational Objective: Trade fixtures - ie, items attached to real property by a tenant for use in his/her trade or business - can be removed without the landlord's consent if the removal (1) occurs before, or within a reasonable time after, the lease ends and (2) will not substantially harm the property. However, the tenant must reasonably restore the property to its prior condition or pay restoration costs.



选项正确率统计：A选项 19%，B选项 0%，C选项 14%，D选项 65%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

未经房东同意，租户不能拆除固定物——即与不动产紧密连接（或附着）而被视为该财产一部分的物品。但是，如果满足以下条件，租户未经房东同意可以拆除营业附加物——即租户为用于其行业或业务而附着于不动产的物品：
  • 物品在租赁终止之前或终止后的合理时间内被拆除，并且
  • 拆除行为不会对物业造成实质性损害（例如，不会降低建筑物的结构完整性）。
但在拆除后，租户必须将物业合理恢复到其先前的状态或支付恢复费用。

在本案中，柜台、陈列柜、可移动货架和特殊照明设备属于营业附加物，因为租户安装它们是为了在其向房东租赁的商铺和停车场中使用。由于没有证据表明拆除这些物品会对物业造成实质性损害，且租赁合同下月才到期，因此租户可以拆除它们。但是，他必须将物业合理恢复到其先前的状态或支付恢复费用（选项C）。

（选项A）尽管租户的一些营业附加物可能是用螺栓固定或以其他方式附着于物业，但没有证据表明拆除它们会造成实质性损害。因此，法院很可能会允许租户拆除所有这些物品，无论它们是如何附着的。

（选项B）固定物被视为房东财产（即不动产）的一部分，但营业附加物不是。相反，租户保留营业附加物的所有权，并在满足上述条件时可以将其从房东的物业中拆除。

教学目标：营业附加物——即租户为用于其行业或业务而附着于不动产的物品——可以在未经房东同意的情况下拆除，如果 (1) 拆除发生在租赁结束之前或结束后的合理时间内，且 (2) 不会对物业造成实质性损害。但是，租户必须将物业合理恢复到其先前的状态或支付恢复费用。

References

Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant §§ 12.2 - 12.3 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (restoration after removal of trade fixtures).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Landlord & Tenant

正确答案：D

支持租户，前提是租户将物业合理地恢复到先前的状态，或支付恢复费用。

核心考点：营业附加物 (Trade Fixtures)

本题考察的是普通法中关于营业附加物 (Trade Fixtures) 的特殊规则。这与一般的“附着物” (Fixtures) 规则有所不同。

一般规则 (General Rule):
通常，附着在土地上的动产 (Chattel) 会成为不动产的一部分 (Fixture)，所有权归房东。
例外规则 (The Exception):
如果该动产是商业租户 (Commercial Tenant) 为了开展业务 (Trade or Business) 而安装的，它被称为 Trade Fixture。

根据普通法，商业租户有权在租赁期结束前拆除营业附加物，即使这些物品已经物理附着在建筑物上（例如用螺栓固定）。

法律推理与应用

在本案中，法院支持租户 (D选项) 的逻辑如下：

  • 性质判定：租户安装的柜台、陈列柜、货架和照明设备，明确是为了其商业经营（商铺）使用的。因此，它们属于 Trade Fixtures，而非普通的 Fixtures。
  • 拆除权利：因为是 Trade Fixtures，租户保留所有权，可以在租约到期前拆除。
  • 附带义务 (Duty to Restore)：这是D选项正确的关键。虽然租户可以拆除，但不能对房东的财产造成永久性损害。租户必须修复因拆除造成的损坏，或支付修复费用，将房屋恢复原状。
选项辨析

选项 A 错误：
它错误地应用了物理附着标准（是否用螺栓固定）。对于 Trade Fixtures，即使物理上紧密附着，只要是为了商业目的且能被分离，通常都允许拆除。

选项 B 错误：
它应用了针对住宅租赁或普通附着物的严格规则，忽略了商业租赁中的 Trade Fixtures 例外。

选项 C 错误：
虽然结论支持租户，但它声称“没有义务恢复物业原状”是错误的。法律不允许租户在拆除设备时留下一个满是洞眼和损坏的烂摊子 (Waste)。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

看到 "Commercial Tenant"（商业租户）安装设备时，立即联想 Trade Fixtures Doctrine。

记住公式：
商业目的 + 租期内拆除 = 允许拆除
但是 -> 必须修复损坏 (Must Restore)

questions.question:
A couple owned a tract of land called Lot 1. An old road ran through Lot 1 from the abutting public highway, which the couple used to haul wood from Lot 1. Without the couple's permission and with no initial right, their neighbor—the owner of Lot 2, which adjoined Lot 1—traveled over the old road for a period of 15 years to obtain access to Lot 2, although Lot 2 abutted another public road. Occasionally, the neighbor made repairs to the old road.
The period of time to acquire rights by prescription in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
After the expiration of 15 years, the couple conveyed a portion of Lot 1 to a friend. The deed included the following clause: "together with the right to pass and repass at all times and for all purposes over the old road." The friend built a house fronting on the old road.
The road was severely damaged by a spring flood, and the friend made substantial repairs to the road. The friend asked the neighbor and the couple to contribute one-third each to the cost of repairing the flood damage. They both refused, and the friend brought an appropriate action to compel contribution from the couple and the neighbor.
What is the likely outcome of this action?

choices.a: The friend will lose as to both defendants.
choices.b: The friend will win as to both defendants.
choices.c: The friend will win as to the couple, but lose as to the neighbor.
choices.d: The friend will win as to the neighbor, but lose as to the couple.

Q86148

A couple owned a tract of land called Lot 1. An old road ran through Lot 1 from the abutting public highway, which the couple used to haul wood from Lot 1. Without the couple's permission and with no initial right, their neighbor - the owner of Lot 2, which adjoined Lot 1 - traveled over the old road for a period of 15 years to obtain access to Lot 2, although Lot 2 abutted another public road. Occasionally, the neighbor made repairs to the old road.

The period of time to acquire rights by prescription in the jurisdiction is 10 years.

After the expiration of 15 years, the couple conveyed a portion of Lot 1 to a friend. The deed included the following clause: "together with the right to pass and repass at all times and for all purposes over the old road." The friend built a house fronting on the old road.

The road was severely damaged by a spring flood, and the friend made substantial repairs to the road. The friend asked the neighbor and the couple to contribute one-third each to the cost of repairing the flood damage. They both refused, and the friend brought an appropriate action to compel contribution from the couple and the neighbor.

What is the likely outcome of this action?

一对夫妇拥有一块名为 Lot 1 的土地。一条旧路从与 Lot 1 相邻的公共高速公路穿过，该夫妇曾用此路从 Lot 1 运送木材。在未经该夫妇许可且无初始权利的情况下，他们的邻居——与 Lot 1 相邻的 Lot 2 的所有者——为了进入 Lot 2 而使用这条旧路长达15年，尽管 Lot 2 本身也邻接另一条公共道路。邻居偶尔会对这条旧路进行维修。

在该司法管辖区，通过时效取得权利的期限为10年。

15年期满后，该夫妇将 Lot 1 的一部分转让给了一位朋友。地契中包含以下条款：“（受让人）享有在任何时候为任何目的通行于该旧路的权利。”这位朋友建了一座房子，正面对着这条旧路。

这条路因春季洪水而严重受损，朋友对道路进行了大量维修。朋友要求邻居和该夫妇各分摊三分之一的洪水损害维修费用。他们都拒绝了，于是朋友提起了适当的诉讼，要求该夫妇和邻居承担分摊费用。

此诉讼可能的结果是什么？
options:
A. The friend will lose as to both defendants.
朋友将对两名被告均败诉。

B. The friend will win as to both defendants.
朋友将对两名被告均胜诉。

C. The friend will win as to the couple, but lose as to the neighbor.
朋友将对该夫妇胜诉，但对邻居败诉。

D. The friend will win as to the neighbor, but lose as to the couple.
朋友将对邻居胜诉，但对该夫妇败诉。
data.explanation:
Repairing & maintaining easement


Duty to repair & maintainDuty to contribute
Easement holder must repair & maintain easement to extent necessary to:
  • prevent unreasonable interference with enjoyment of servient estate
  • protect servient-estate owner from liability to third parties
Other easement holders and/or servient-estate owner who share easement must contribute to reasonable costs of repairs & maintenance
The duty to repair and maintain an easement falls on the easement holder† - not the servient-estate owner (unless the parties agree otherwise). However, the servient-estate owner has a duty to contribute to the reasonable costs of repairs and maintenance if he/she also uses the easement. The same applies to other easement holders who share the use of the easement.

Here, the couple (servient-estate owner) conveyed an easement to the friend that allowed the friend to use the old road on their land. But the couple also used the road to haul wood. And the neighbor obtained a prescriptive easement to use the road by openly and continuously using the road for 15 years without the couple's permission. As a result, the couple and the neighbor were obligated to contribute to the costs incurred by the friend in repairing the road. Therefore, the friend will likely win against both in his action to compel contribution (Choices A, C & D).

†This obligation also extends to repair and maintenance of portions of the servient estate and improvements used to enjoy the easement, so long as they are within the easement holder's control.

Educational objective: An easement holder has a duty to repair and maintain the easement. If the easement is shared by other easement holders or the servient-estate owner, those parties are obligated to contribute to the reasonable costs of repairs and maintenance.

选项正确率统计：A选项 29%，B选项 30%（正确选项），C选项 18%，D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

维修与维护地役权


维修与维护义务分摊义务
地役权持有人必须在必要范围内维修和维护地役权，以：
  • 防止对需役地（servient estate）的享用造成不合理的干扰
  • 保护需役地所有者免于对第三方承担责任
共享地役权的其他地役权持有人和/或需役地所有者必须分摊合理的维修和维护费用
维修和维护地役权的义务由地役权持有人†承担——而非需役地所有者（除非各方另有约定）。但是，如果需役地所有者也使用该地役权，则其有义务分摊合理的维修和维护费用。此规定同样适用于共享地役权的其他地役权持有人。

在本案中，该夫妇（需役地所有者）向朋友转让了一项地役权，允许朋友使用他们土地上的旧路。但该夫妇也使用这条路来运送木材。而邻居通过未经该夫妇许可、公开且持续地使用该道路15年，获得了使用该道路的时效地役权（prescriptive easement）。因此，该夫妇和邻居都有义务分摊朋友维修道路所产生的费用。所以，朋友提起的强制分摊诉讼很可能会对二者均胜诉（选项 A、C 和 D 错误）。

†此义务也延伸至维修和维护为享用地役权而使用的需役地部分及相关改良设施，只要它们在地役权持有人的控制范围内。

教学目的：地役权持有人有义务维修和维护地役权。如果该地役权由其他地役权持有人或需役地所有者共享，则这些当事人有义务分摊合理的维修和维护费用。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 4.13 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (duty to repair and maintain easement).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：地役权 (Easements)

正确答案：B
(朋友将对两名被告均胜诉)
Real Property Easements Duty to Repair

核心法律规则 (The Rule)

共同使用规则 (Shared Use Rule)：
根据《财产法重述（第三版）：地役权》(Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes)，地役权的维修和维护义务通常由地役权人 (Easement Holder) 承担。

但是，如果地役权由多个地役权人共享，或者由地役权人和供役地所有人 (Servient Estate Owner) 共同使用，那么所有受益方都有义务根据其使用情况分摊合理的维修费用 (Contribution)。

案情深度拆解

1. 邻居的法律地位 (The Neighbor)

邻居在没有许可的情况下使用了道路15年，而该州的法定失效期是10年。因此，邻居已经成功获得了时效地役权 (Prescriptive Easement)。

这意味着邻居不再是侵权者，而是合法的地役权持有人，因此有义务分摊维护费用。

2. 夫妇的法律地位 (The Couple)

夫妇是供役地所有人 (Servient Estate Owners)。通常情况下，供役地所有人没有义务维修地役权设施。

关键例外：题目明确指出夫妇“曾用此路运送木材”且并未停止使用。因为他们也在主动使用这条道路，所以他们必须分摊维修费用。

3. 朋友的法律地位 (The Friend)

朋友通过地契获得了明示地役权 (Express Easement)。作为主要的维修发起人，他有权要求其他共同受益人（邻居和夫妇）分摊费用。

逻辑推演图示

  • ✅ 朋友 (Friend): 使用者 (User) ➔ 需付费
  • ✅ 邻居 (Neighbor): 时效取得者 (User) ➔ 需付费
  • ✅ 夫妇 (Couple): 供役地主 + 使用者 (User) ➔ 需付费

结论：三方共同分摊 (Contribution)

💡 考场技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理地役权维修费用问题时，不要只看谁拥有土地所有权。MBE 的考点通常在于“谁在使用” (Usage)。

如果供役地所有人 (Owner of Servient Estate) 仅仅是让地役权人通过，自己不用，那他通常不需要付钱。但一旦题目提到他也使用该设施（如本题中的 haul wood），他就必须分摊费用。

questions.question:
A man's home was mortgaged to a bank by a duly recorded purchase-money mortgage. Last year, the man replaced all of the home's old windows with new windows.
Each new window consists of a window frame with three inserts: regular windows, storm windows, and screens. The windows are designed so that each insert can be easily inserted or removed from the window frame without tools to adjust to seasonal change and to facilitate the cleaning of the inserts.
The new windows were expensive. The man purchased them on credit, signed a financing statement, and granted a security interest in the windows to the supplier of the windows. The supplier promptly and properly filed and recorded the financing statement before the windows were installed. The man stored the old windows in the basement of the home.
This year, the man has suffered severe financial reverses and has defaulted on his mortgage obligation to the bank and on his obligation to the supplier.
The bank brought an appropriate action to enjoin the supplier from its proposed repossession of the window inserts.
In the action, for whom should the court rule?

choices.a: The bank, because its mortgage was recorded first.
choices.b: The bank, because windows and screens, no matter their characteristics, are an integral part of a house.
choices.c: The supplier, because the availability of the old windows enables the bank to return the home to its original condition.
choices.d: The supplier, because the inserts are removable.

data.questionStem:
Q86160

A man's home was mortgaged to a bank by a duly recorded purchase-money mortgage. Last year, the man replaced all of the home's old windows with new windows.

Each new window consists of a window frame with three inserts: regular windows, storm windows, and screens. The windows are designed so that each insert can be easily inserted or removed from the window frame without tools to adjust to seasonal change and to facilitate the cleaning of the inserts.

The new windows were expensive. The man purchased them on credit, signed a financing statement, and granted a security interest in the windows to the supplier of the windows. The supplier promptly and properly filed and recorded the financing statement before the windows were installed. The man stored the old windows in the basement of the home.

This year, the man has suffered severe financial reverses and has defaulted on his mortgage obligation to the bank and on his obligation to the supplier.

The bank brought an appropriate action to enjoin the supplier from its proposed repossession of the window inserts.

In the action, for whom should the court rule?

一名男子的房屋通过正式记录的购房抵押贷款向银行办理了抵押。去年，该男子将房屋的所有旧窗户更换为新窗户。

每扇新窗户由一个窗框和三个可插入部分组成：普通窗、防风窗和纱窗。这些窗户的设计使得每个可插入部分无需工具即可轻松地从窗框中装入或取出，以适应季节变化并方便清洁。

这些新窗户价格昂贵。该男子通过信贷购买，签署了一份融资声明，并将窗户的担保权益授予了窗户的供应商。在窗户安装之前，供应商及时并适当地提交并记录了该融资声明。该男子将旧窗户存放在房屋的地下室中。

今年，该男子遭遇了严重的财务困境，拖欠了对银行的抵押贷款债务以及对供应商的债务。

银行提起了适当的诉讼，请求禁止供应商收回其提议要收回的窗户可插入部分。

在该诉讼中，法院应裁定哪一方胜诉？
options:
A. The bank, because its mortgage was recorded first.
银行，因为其抵押贷款先被记录。

B. The bank, because windows and screens, no matter their characteristics, are an integral part of a house.
银行，因为无论其特性如何，窗户和纱窗都是房屋不可分割的一部分。

C. The supplier, because the availability of the old windows enables the bank to return the home to its original condition.
供应商，因为旧窗户的存在使得银行能够将房屋恢复到其原始状态。

D. The supplier, because the inserts are removable.
供应商，因为这些可插入部分是可拆卸的。
data.explanation:
A mortgage is a lien against real property that is used to secure repayment of a debt. This gives the recipient of the mortgage (ie, the mortgagee) a legal interest in the mortgaged property and any fixtures later added to that property. A fixture is an object (ie, personal property) that is:
  • attached to real property with the intent that it remain attached and
  • used for some larger component (eg, lighting, water drainage) or function (eg, plumbing, septic) of the real property.

In other words, a fixture is an object that is so attached to real property that it is essentially a part of that property.

Here, the new window inserts were integral as a larger component of the man's house. But they are not fixtures because they are easily removable and therefore not attached to the house. As a result, the window inserts are not part of the bank's purchase-money mortgage. This means that the bank has no standing to enjoin (ie, stop) the supplier from repossessing them (Choice B).

(Choice A) A first recorded lien generally has priority over subsequent liens on the same property, and a purchase-money mortgage (recorded or not) generally has priority over all other liens on the property. But here, priority is irrelevant since the bank and the supplier have mortgages over different property - the home and new windows, respectively.

(Choice C) Since the window inserts are easily removable, they would not be fixtures even if the old windows were unavailable and the bank could not return the home to its original condition.

Educational objective: A mortgage includes the property and any fixtures added to that property before or after the mortgage was created. A fixture is an item that is (1) attached to property with the intent that it remain attached and (2) used for a larger component or function of the property.



选项正确率统计：A选项 16%，B选项 22%，C选项 26%，D选项 34%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

抵押是针对不动产的一种留置权，用于担保债务的偿还。这使得抵押权的接受方（即受押人）对抵押财产以及之后增添到该财产上的任何固定附着物拥有合法权益。固定附着物是一种（即动产）物体，它：
  • 附着于不动产，并意图使其保持附着状态并且
  • 用于不动产的某个更大部分（例如，照明、排水）或功能（例如，管道、化粪池）。

换言之，固定附着物是如此附着于不动产的物体，以至于它实质上已成为该财产的一部分。

在本案中，新的窗户可插入部分作为该男子房屋的一个更大部分是不可或缺的。但它们不是固定附着物，因为它们易于拆卸，因此并未附着于房屋。因此，窗户可插入部分不属于银行购房抵押贷款的范围。这意味着银行没有诉讼资格来禁止（即阻止）供应商收回它们（选项 B）。

（选项 A） 首先记录的留置权通常优先于对同一财产的后续留置权，而购房抵押贷款（无论是否记录）通常优先于对该财产的所有其他留置权。但在本案中，优先权问题无关紧要，因为银行和供应商的抵押权分别针对不同的财产——即房屋和新窗户。

（选项 C） 由于窗户可插入部分易于拆卸，即使没有旧窗户可用，银行也无法将房屋恢复到其原始状态，它们也不会是固定附着物。

教学目标：抵押范围包括财产本身以及在抵押设立前后增添到该财产上的任何固定附着物。固定附着物是指一个物品，它 (1) 附着于财产，并意图使其保持附着状态，并且 (2) 用于该财产的某个更大部分或功能。

References

35A Am. Jur. 2d Fixtures § 1 (2019) (defining fixture).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property
✅ 正确答案：D

本题的核心考点在于区分固定附着物 (Fixtures) 与 动产 (Chattel/Personal Property)。

法律规则：附着物 vs. 动产

在不动产法中，物品的分类决定了抵押权 (Mortgage) 是否覆盖该物品：

  • 固定附着物 (Fixture)： 指附着于土地或建筑物，且意图使其成为不动产永久一部分的物品。
    → 属于不动产抵押权的范围。
  • 动产 (Chattel)： 未永久附着，可以轻易移动的个人财产。
    → 不属于不动产抵押权的范围（除非有特定的动产担保）。
判断标准 (The Test)

法院通常依据以下三点来判断：

  1. 附着程度 (Annexation)： 移除该物品是否会损坏不动产？
  2. 适应性 (Adaptation)： 该物品是否专门为该特定不动产定制？
  3. 意图 (Intent)： 安装者是否打算让其永久存在？（这是最重要的因素）。
本案分析

事实关键点：

  • 题目明确指出窗户的“可插入部分”（inserts）设计为无需工具即可轻松装入或取出。
  • 目的是为了适应季节变化和方便清洁。

推理逻辑：

虽然窗框 (Window Frames) 已经被钉入墙体，属于固定附着物，但可插入部分 (Inserts) 保持了其独立性。由于它们可以轻易拆卸且不损坏房屋结构，法律上视其为动产 (Chattel)。

结论：

银行的抵押权 (Mortgage) 仅覆盖不动产（土地+房屋+固定附着物）。因为可插入部分是动产，银行对其没有留置权。相反，供应商拥有针对这些动产的担保权益 (Security Interest)。因此，供应商有权收回这些部件。

干扰项排除
❌ 选项 A (银行先记录)：
优先权规则 (Priority Rules) 仅在双方都对同一物品拥有权益时才适用。既然这些部件是动产，银行的不动产抵押权根本不覆盖它们，所以不存在优先权之争。
❌ 选项 B (不可分割的一部分)：
这是一个事实认定的错误。虽然窗户对房子很重要，但题目特意强调了“易于拆卸”这一物理特性，这在法律上压倒了功能上的整合性。
❌ 选项 C (旧窗户可恢复原状)：
这混淆了“机构性原则” (Institutional Doctrine)。即使没有旧窗户，只要新部件的移除不会对房屋造成物理损害，它们通常仍被视为动产。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理 Fixtures 题目时，请密切关注题目中关于物理附着方式的描述。

如果题目出现 "easily removable" (易于移除)、"without tools" (无需工具) 或 "without damage" (无损) 等字眼，这通常是考官在暗示该物品仍为动产 (Chattel)，因此不受不动产抵押权的约束。

questions.question:
A large tract of land is owned by a religious order. The order erected a large residential building on the land where its members reside. The order's land is surrounded by rural residential properties and its only access to a public way is afforded by an easement over a strip of land 30 feet wide. The easement was granted to the order by deed from a woman who owned one of the adjacent residential properties. The order built a driveway on the strip, and the easement was used for 20 years without incident or objection.
Last year, as permitted by the applicable zoning ordinance, the order constructed a 200-bed nursing home and a parking lot on its land, using all of the land that was available for such development. The nursing home was very successful, and on Sundays visitors to the nursing home overflowed the parking facilities on the land and parked all along the driveway from early in the morning through the evening hours. After two Sundays of the resulting congestion and inconvenience, the woman erected a barrier across the driveway on Sundays preventing any use of the driveway by anyone seeking access to the order's land. The order objected.
The woman brought an appropriate action to terminate the easement.
In this action, for whom will the court likely hold?

choices.a: The order, because expanded use of the easement does not terminate the easement.
choices.b: The order, because the woman's use of self-help denies her the right to equitable relief.
choices.c: The woman, because the order excessively expanded the use of the dominant tenement.
choices.d: The woman, because the parking on the driveway exceeded the scope of the easement.

A large tract of land is owned by a religious order. The order erected a large residential building on the land where its members reside. The order's land is surrounded by rural residential properties and its only access to a public way is afforded by an easement over a strip of land 30 feet wide. The easement was granted to the order by deed from a woman who owned one of the adjacent residential properties. The order built a driveway on the strip, and the easement was used for 20 years without incident or objection.

Last year, as permitted by the applicable zoning ordinance, the order constructed a 200-bed nursing home and a parking lot on its land, using all of the land that was available for such development. The nursing home was very successful, and on Sundays visitors to the nursing home overflowed the parking facilities on the land and parked all along the driveway from early in the morning through the evening hours. After two Sundays of the resulting congestion and inconvenience, the woman erected a barrier across the driveway on Sundays preventing any use of the driveway by anyone seeking access to the order's land. The order objected.

The woman brought an appropriate action to terminate the easement.

In this action, for whom will the court likely hold?

一个宗教团体拥有一大片土地。该团体在土地上建造了一栋大型住宅楼，供其成员居住。该团体的土地被乡村住宅物业所环绕，其通往公共道路的唯一通道是通过一条30英尺宽地带上的地役权（easement）。该地役权是由一位拥有相邻住宅物业之一的女士通过契据授予该团体的。该团体在该地带上修建了一条车道，该地役权在20年间的使用中未发生任何事故或异议。

去年，根据适用的区划法规的许可，该团体在其土地上建造了一家拥有200个床位的疗养院和一个停车场，用尽了所有可用于此类开发的土地。疗养院非常成功，在周日，疗养院的访客挤满了土地上的停车设施，并从清晨到傍晚一直沿着车道停车。在经历了两个周日的拥堵和不便之后，该女士在周日于车道上设置了一个障碍物，阻止任何试图进入该团体土地的人使用车道。该团体提出了异议。

该女士提起了适当的诉讼，要求终止该地役权。

在此诉讼中，法院可能会支持哪一方？
options:
A. The order, because expanded use of the easement does not terminate the easement.
该团体，因为地役权的扩大使用不会导致地役权的终止。

B. The order, because the woman's use of self-help denies her the right to equitable relief.
该团体，因为该女士使用自力救济（self-help）使其无权获得衡平法上的救济（equitable relief）。

C. The woman, because the order excessively expanded the use of the dominant tenement.
该女士，因为该团体过度扩大了需役地（dominant tenement）的使用。

D. The woman, because the parking on the driveway exceeded the scope of the easement.
该女士，因为在车道上停车超出了地役权的范围。
data.explanation:
Permissible use of easement


TypeEasement holder's useServient owner's use
Express easementUses intended by parties OR reasonably necessary to use/enjoy easement if intent is unknown Expansion of use permittedUse consistent with easement's terms AND does not unreasonably interfere with its use/enjoyment
Easement by prior useLimited to scope of prior use No expansion of use
Easement by necessityNormal uses needed for dominant estate (eg, ingress/egress, utility lines) Expansion of use permitted
Prescriptive easementLimited to scope of adverse use during prescriptive period No expansion of use
An easement is generally a nonpossessory right to use another's land (ie, servient estate) for a specific purpose. Unless limited by the express terms of the easement, the easement holder has the right to use the servient estate in any manner that is reasonably necessary to use and enjoy the easement - eg, building a driveway on the easement and using the driveway for parking (Choice D).

An easement also anticipates reasonable and natural development of the easement holder's land (ie, dominant estate). Therefore, the easement holder may increase the manner, frequency, and intensity of the easement's use - so long as that increase does not unreasonably damage or interfere with the use or enjoyment of the servient estate.

Here, the order reasonably developed its land as permitted by the zoning ordinance by constructing a 200-bed nursing home and parking lot on it. This caused an increase in the intensity and frequency of the easement's use. But that use was not excessive because there is no evidence that it unreasonably damaged or interfered with the woman's servient estate (Choice C). Even if it did, available remedies would include self-help abatement (eg, blocking off the easement), damages, or an injunction - not termination or forfeiture of the easement (Choice B).

Educational objective: An easement holder may increase the manner, frequency, or intensity of an easement's use so long as that increase does not unreasonably damage or interfere with the use or enjoyment of the servient estate.

选项正确率统计：A选项 47%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 15%，D选项 34%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

地役权的允许使用


类型地役权人(Easement holder)的使用供役地所有人(Servient owner)的使用
明示地役权 (Express easement)双方意图的使用，或在意图不明时为使用/享用地役权而合理必要的使用。允许扩大使用。与地役权条款一致且不无理干涉其使用/享用的使用。
先前使用形成的地役权 (Easement by prior use)限于先前使用的范围。不允许扩大使用。
必要地役权 (Easement by necessity)需役地（dominant estate）所需的正常使用（例如，出入、公用事业线路）。允许扩大使用。
时效地役权 (Prescriptive easement)限于时效期内的侵权逆占使用范围。不允许扩大使用。
地役权(easement)通常是一种非占有性权利，为特定目的而使用他人土地（即供役地，servient estate）。除非地役权的明示条款有所限制，地役权人有权以任何合理必要的方式使用供役地，以使用和享用地役权——例如，在地役权上修建车道和使用车道停车(选项D)。

地役权也预见了地役权人土地（即需役地，dominant estate）的合理和自然发展。因此，地役权人可以增加地役权使用的方式、频率和强度——只要这种增加不会对供役地的使用或享有造成不合理的损害或干涉。

在本案中，该团体根据区划法规的许可，通过建造一个有200个床位的疗养院和停车场，合理地开发了其土地。这导致了地役权使用强度和频率的增加。但这种使用并未过度，因为没有证据表明它不合理地损害或干涉了女士的供役地(选项C)。即使确实如此，可用的救济措施将包括自力救济减免（例如，封锁地役权）、损害赔偿或禁令——而不是终止或丧失地役权(选项B)。

教学目标：地役权人可以增加地役权使用的模式、频率或强度，只要这种增加不会对供役地的使用或享有造成不合理的损害或干涉。

References

  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 4.10 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (easement holder's right to use easement).
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 4.9 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (servient owner's right to use servient estate).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Easements
正确答案：A
法院将支持该团体 (The Order)。
核心考点：地役权的范围与救济 Scope of Easement & Remedies for Surcharge

本题考察两个关键原则：

  1. 地役权的使用可以随着需役地（Dominant Estate）的合理发展而演变。
  2. 即使过度使用（Surcharge），救济措施通常是禁令或损害赔偿，而非终止地役权。
法律逻辑推演

1. 合理发展原则 (Reasonable Development)

明示地役权（Express Easement）并非一成不变。法律假定双方在设立地役权时，已经预见到了土地的自然和合理发展。只要新的使用方式对于享用地役权是“合理必要”的，且没有对供役地（Servient Estate）造成不合理的负担，这种扩大使用是被允许的。

在本案中，从住宅楼变为疗养院符合当地 Zoning（区划法），属于土地的合理发展。

2. 关键转折：救济措施 (The Remedy)

这是本题最大的陷阱。即使我们假设在车道上停车（Parking on the driveway）确实构成了过度使用（Surcharge），供役地所有人的正确诉求应该是申请禁令 (Injunction) 禁止停车，或者索取损害赔偿。

过度使用不会导致地役权自动终止 (Termination)。

情形 法律后果
合理扩大使用
(Reasonable Expansion)		 允许。供役地所有人必须容忍。
过度使用/超出负担
(Surcharge)		 不允许。但救济是禁令或赔偿，不是没收/终止权利。
为什么选 A 而不是 C 或 D？
  • 选项 A (正确)：指出了核心法律原则——仅仅因为使用范围扩大（甚至某种程度的滥用），并不足以导致地役权被彻底废除。
  • 选项 C & D (错误)：这两个选项都试图论证该团体的行为是错误的（过度扩大或超出范围）。虽然在车道上停车可能确实超出了范围，但题目的问题是“法院是否会支持终止地役权的诉讼”。因为过度使用不等于终止，所以即便 C 和 D 的事实描述部分正确，结论（支持女士终止地役权）也是错误的。
  • 选项 B (错误)：虽然“自力救济” (Self-help，即女士设置路障) 是相关的，但法院判决该团体胜诉的根本原因不是因为女士行为不当，而是因为法律不支持因过度使用而“判处死刑”（终止地役权）。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧 在做 Property 题目时，一定要看清原告寻求的具体救济 (Remedy) 是什么。

如果题目问：“女士能否获得禁令禁止停车？”答案可能是 Yes (因为停车可能阻碍通行)。
但题目问的是：“女士能否终止地役权？”答案几乎永远是 No。

记住：滥用不等于没收 (Misuse does not equal forfeiture)。

questions.question:
Pursuant to a city ordinance, a particular area was zoned for single-family residences. The ordinance allowed a licensed professional, upon acquiring a permit, to maintain an office within one of the residences for use in meeting with clients and other parties in connection with the pursuit of the individual's profession. A licensed psychiatrist purchased a residence within the area zoned for single-family residences. The psychiatrist properly applied for a permit from the zoning commission and established that she met the conditions for granting the permit, but she cannot prove that the denial of the permit would result in an unnecessary hardship to her.
Can the zoning commission properly deny the psychiatrist a permit?

choices.a: No, because she has a vested right in maintaining a home office in her residence.
choices.b: No, because she properly applied for and established her entitlement to the permit.
choices.c: Yes, because she cannot establish that the denial of the permit would result in an unnecessary hardship to her.
choices.d: Yes, because the granting of a permit is a matter within the discretion of the zoning commission.

data.questionStem:
Q86185

Pursuant to a city ordinance, a particular area was zoned for single-family residences. The ordinance allowed a licensed professional, upon acquiring a permit, to maintain an office within one of the residences for use in meeting with clients and other parties in connection with the pursuit of the individual's profession. A licensed psychiatrist purchased a residence within the area zoned for single-family residences. The psychiatrist properly applied for a permit from the zoning commission and established that she met the conditions for granting the permit, but she cannot prove that the denial of the permit would result in an unnecessary hardship to her.

Can the zoning commission properly deny the psychiatrist a permit?

根据一项城市条例，某一特定区域被划为独栋住宅区。该条例允许有执照的专业人士在获得许可后，在其中一处住宅内设立办公室，用于会见客户及与个人执业相关的其他方。一位有执照的精神科医生在划为独栋住宅的区域内购买了一处住宅。该精神科医生向区域划分委员会正式申请了许可，并证明她满足了授予许可的条件，但她无法证明拒绝该许可将给她带来不必要的困境。

区域划分委员会能否正当拒绝授予该精神科医生许可？
options:
A. No, because she has a vested right in maintaining a home office in her residence.
不可以，因为她对其住宅内设立家庭办公室享有既得权利。

B. No, because she properly applied for and established her entitlement to the permit.
不可以，因为她已正式申请并证明了自己有权获得该许可。

C. Yes, because she cannot establish that the denial of the permit would result in an unnecessary hardship to her.
可以，因为她无法证明拒绝该许可会给她带来不必要的困境。

D. Yes, because the granting of a permit is a matter within the discretion of the zoning commission.
可以，因为授予许可属于区域划分委员会的自由裁量权范围。
data.explanation:
A zoning ordinance is a governmental regulation regarding land use that, for example, limits the use of a particular area to single-family residences. The ordinance may include a special exception permitting a particular future use of property if a special-use permit is obtained. If a property owner complies with the procedures for obtaining a special-use permit and establishes entitlement to that permit (as the psychiatrist did here), the responsible government agency must issue the permit. Therefore, the zoning commission cannot properly deny the psychiatrist a permit.†

If the property owner is denied a permit, procedural due process typically gives the owner the right to appeal the denial to a reviewing entity (eg, a board of zoning appeals).

(Choice A) A vested right regarding a nonconforming use of property exists when, at the time a zoning ordinance takes effect, the property owner is using the property in a manner that violates the ordinance. Here, the psychiatrist did not have a home office when the ordinance was enacted, so she has no vested right in this use.

(Choice C) Proof of unnecessary hardship is not needed to obtain a special-use permit. However, such proof is required to obtain a variance. Under a variance, a local government (often a zoning board) gives a landowner permission to use his/her property in a manner that is not permitted under the zoning ordinance - eg, the use falls outside of a special exception.

(Choice D) The granting of a special-use permit is not subject to the discretion of the zoning commission when, as here, the property owner has established that the conditions for granting the permit have been met.

Educational objective: A property owner must be granted a special-use permit if the property owner has complied with the procedures for obtaining the permit and has established entitlement to the permit.

选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 42%（正确选项），C选项 17%，D选项 37%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

区域划分条例 (zoning ordinance) 是一项关于土地使用的政府法规，例如，它将特定区域的用途限制为独栋住宅。该条例可包含一项特别豁免 (special exception)，即在获得特殊用途许可的情况下，允许对财产进行特定的未来使用。如果财产所有人遵守了获得特殊用途许可的程序，并证明了其获得该许可的权利（如此处的精神科医生所做），则负责的政府机构必须颁发该许可。因此，区域划分委员会不能正当拒绝授予该精神科医生许可。†

如果财产所有人被拒绝授予许可，程序性正当程序 (procedural due process) 通常赋予所有者向审查实体（例如，区域划分上诉委员会）对拒绝决定提出上诉的权利。

(选项A) 当区域划分条例生效时，如果财产所有人正在以违反该条例的方式使用财产，则存在关于财产不合规使用的既得权利 (vested right regarding a nonconforming use)。在本案中，该条例颁布时，精神科医生并没有家庭办公室，因此她对这种使用方式不享有既得权利。

(选项C) 获得特殊用途许可不需要证明不必要的困境 (unnecessary hardship)。但是，获得用途变更许可 (variance) 则需要此类证明。根据用途变更许可，地方政府（通常是区域划分委员会）允许土地所有者以区域划分条例所不允许的方式使用其财产——例如，该使用方式不属于特别豁免的范围。

(选项D) 当财产所有人已经证明授予许可的条件已得到满足时（如此案所示），授予特殊用途许可不属于区域划分委员会的自由裁量权 (discretion) 范围。

教学目标：如果财产所有人遵守了获得许可的程序，并证明了其有权获得该许可，则必须授予其特殊用途许可。

References

83 Am. Jur. 2d Zoning and Planning § 814 (2020) (discussing special exceptions or uses).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Zoning

核心考点：特别例外 vs. 变更许可 本题考察的是 Special Exception（特别例外，又称 Conditional Use Permit）与 Variance（变更许可）的区别。这是 MBE 财产法部分极易混淆的概念。

Special Exception

定义：条例中明确允许的用途，但需要满足特定条件。

性质：符合条件的“权利”。

要求：只需证明满足条例规定的条件。

是否需要困境证明？
不需要 (No Hardship)

Variance

定义：请求允许违反现行分区条例。

性质：对规则的豁免。

要求：必须证明土地具有独特性。

是否需要困境证明？
需要 (Unnecessary Hardship)

案情逻辑分析

在本案中，城市条例（Ordinance）本身就允许（allowed）专业人士在获得许可后设立办公室。这意味着该用途是分区规划的一部分，属于 Special Exception。

题目明确指出：精神科医生已经证明她满足了授予许可的条件 (established that she met the conditions)。

法律结论： 当申请人满足了 Special Exception 的法定条件时，委员会没有自由裁量权 (No discretion) 去拒绝，必须颁发许可。

选项深度解析

✅ 选项 B (正确答案)
"No, because she properly applied for and established her entitlement to the permit."

解析：这是对 Special Exception 规则的直接应用。一旦申请人证明符合条例预设的条件，委员会的批准行为就变成了行政性义务 (Ministerial duty)，而非自由裁量。
❌ 选项 C (常见陷阱)
"Yes, because she cannot establish that the denial of the permit would result in an unnecessary hardship to her."

解析：这是本题最大的干扰项。证明 Unnecessary Hardship（不必要的困境）是申请 Variance (变更许可) 的要求，而不是 Special Exception 的要求。因为医生申请的是条例允许的用途，她不需要证明困境。
❌ 选项 D (错误理由)
"...matter within the discretion of the zoning commission."

解析：虽然委员会在判断“是否满足条件”时有一定裁量权，但一旦事实证明条件已满足（题目已给定此事实），他们就没有拒绝的自由裁量权。
❌ 选项 A (概念混淆)
"...vested right..."

解析：Vested Right（既得权利）通常用于保护 Nonconforming Use（不合规使用）。这要求在条例生效前该用途就已经存在。本案中医生是在条例生效后购买并申请的，因此没有既得权利。
💡 MBE 考试通关秘籍

看到 Zoning 问题时，第一步先判断申请人想要做什么：
  1. 如果是条例里写着“允许...但需许可”：这是 Special Exception。只要满足条件，必须批准。不需要 Hardship。
  2. 如果是条例里“禁止”该用途，但申请人想破例：这是 Variance。必须证明 Unnecessary Hardship 且不损害公众利益。

questions.question:
A restauranteur's friend owned land that included a lake within its boundaries. In a writing, the friend granted the restauranteur a profit that gave her the right to access the lake for the purpose of taking fish from it. For nine years, the restauranteur took fish from the lake and served them in various dishes at her restaurant. During the tenth year, the restauranteur entered negotiations to sell the restaurant to a chef who planned to continue operating the restaurant. The terms of the profit did not address its transferability.
Which of the following would be most important in determining whether the restauranteur could assign her right to remove fish from the lake to the chef as part of the sale of the restaurant?

choices.a: Whether the friend and the restauranteur intended the right to be personal to the restauranteur.
choices.b: Whether the friend granted others the right to take fish from the lake.
choices.c: Whether the friend retained the right to take fish from the lake for himself.
choices.d: Whether the restauranteur recorded the right.

Which of the following would be most important in determining whether the restauranteur could assign her right to remove fish from the lake to the chef as part of the sale of the restaurant?

一位餐馆老板的朋友拥有一片土地，其边界内有一个湖。该朋友以书面形式授予了餐馆老板一项取益权（profit），赋予她进入湖泊捕鱼的权利。九年来，该餐馆老板一直在湖中捕鱼，并在她的餐厅里将这些鱼做成各种菜肴。在第十年，该餐馆老板与一位计划继续经营该餐厅的厨师进行谈判，准备出售餐厅。该取益权的条款并未涉及其可转让性。

在决定该餐馆老板是否可以在出售餐厅时，将其从湖中捕鱼的权利转让给厨师，以下哪一项最为重要？
options:
A. Whether the friend and the restauranteur intended the right to be personal to the restauranteur.
该朋友和餐馆老板是否意图将此权利设定为餐馆老板的属人权。

B. Whether the friend granted others the right to take fish from the lake.
该朋友是否授予了其他人从湖中捕鱼的权利。

C. Whether the friend retained the right to take fish from the lake for himself.
该朋友是否为自己保留了从湖中捕鱼的权利。

D. Whether the restauranteur recorded the right.
该餐馆老板是否对该权利进行了登记。
data.explanation:
Profit

(right to enter another's land & remove natural resources)
CharacteristicsTransferabilityApportionability
ExclusiveUnlimited & exclusive rightCan be transferred unless profit is personal or contrary to parties' intentIf transferable, can be divided unless contrary to parties' intent or burden on servient estate unreasonably increased
NonexclusiveRight limited by quantity, use, or time OR shared with another
A profit (ie, profit à prendre) is a nonpossessory right to enter another's land and remove specific natural resources (eg, oil, gas, minerals, timber, fish). A profit may generally be transferred (eg, assigned) unless the profit is personal or transfer would be contrary to the intent of the parties creating the profit. A profit is personal if the relationship of the parties or other circumstances indicate that it was not intended to be transferable.

This means that the restauranteur's ability to assign her right to remove fish from the lake to the chef turns on whether the friend and restauranteur intended the profit to be personal to the restauranteur (eg, because they were friends). If so, then the restauranteur cannot assign the profit to the chef. But if the profit was intended to benefit the restauranteur's business, then the restauranteur can assign the profit to the chef purchasing her restaurant.

(Choices B & C) When someone else - including the owner of the servient (burdened) estate - enjoys the same right as the profit holder, the profit is nonexclusive. The nonexclusivity of a profit may affect whether the profit holder can divide the profit among other persons, and it may be a factor in determining whether the parties intended the profit to be personal. But it is not itself determinative of whether the profit may be transferred to another.

(Choice D) Recording the profit would protect the restauranteur if the profit is exclusive and the friend subsequently grants a similar right to a third party. However, this would not preclude the profit from being considered personal to the restauranteur and therefore nontransferable.

Educational objective: A profit - ie, nonpossessory right to enter another's land and remove specific natural resources - may generally be transferred unless the profit is personal or transfer would be contrary to the intent of the parties creating the profit.

选项正确率统计：A选项 80%（正确选项），B选项 4%，C选项 4%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

取益权（Profit）

（进入他人土地并取走自然资源的权利）
特征可转让性可分配性
排他性无限且排他的权利可以转让，除非该取益权是属人性的或与当事人的意图相悖若可转让，则可以分割，除非与当事人意图相悖或不合理地增加了地役地产的负担
非排他性权利受限于数量、用途或时间，或与他人共享
取益权（profit，即 profit à prendre）是一种非占有性权利，指进入他人土地并取走特定自然资源（如石油、天然气、矿物、木材、鱼类）的权利。取益权通常可以转让（如，让与），除非该取益权是属人性的，或者转让会违背创设该取益权的当事人的意图。如果当事人之间的关系或其他情况表明，其意图并非是可转让的，则该取益权是属人性的。

这意味着，餐馆老板能否将其从湖中捕鱼的权利转让给厨师，取决于该朋友和餐馆老板是否意图将该取益权设定为餐馆老板的属人权（例如，因为他们是朋友）。如果是这样，那么餐馆老板不能将该取益权转让给厨师。但如果该取益权的意图是为了使餐馆老板的生意受益，那么餐馆老板可以将该取益权转让给购买她餐厅的厨师。

（选项B和C）当其他人——包括地役地产（承受负担的地产）的所有人——享有与取益权持有人相同的权利时，该取益权是非排他性的。取益权的非排他性可能会影响取益权持有人是否可以将该权利在其他人之间进行分割，并且它可能是决定当事人是否意图将该取益权设定为属人权的一个因素。但它本身并不能决定该取益权是否可以转让给他人。

（选项D）如果该取益权是排他性的，并且该朋友随后向第三方授予了类似的权利，那么对取益权进行登记将能保护餐馆老板。然而，这并不能排除该取益权被认定为对餐馆老板而言是属人性的，并因此不可转让。

教学目的：取益权——即进入他人土地并取走特定自然资源的非占有性权利——通常可以转让，除非该取益权是属人性的，或者转让会违背创设该取益权的当事人的意图。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property (Servitudes) § 4.6 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (transferability of servitude benefits).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Profit à Prendre

核心概念：取益权 (Profit)

取益权 (Profit à Prendre) 是一种非占有性的土地权益，赋予持有人进入他人土地并取走自然资源（如鱼、木材、矿物）的权利。

取益权主要分为两类：

  • 从属取益权 (Profit Appurtenant)：为了受益于特定的土地（需役地）而存在，随土地转让。
  • 独立取益权 (Profit in Gross)：为了受益于特定的人而存在，不依附于土地。本题属于此类。

法律规则：转让性 (Transferability)

对于独立取益权 (Profit in Gross)，其转让性取决于它是“商业性”的还是“属人性”的：

一般规则：独立取益权通常是可以转让的 (Assignable)，除非当事人意图将其设定为属人的 (Personal)。
  • 商业性 (Commercial)：通常被推定为可转让。
  • 属人性 (Personal)：通常不可转让。

本题解析逻辑

1
识别冲突：题目中存在两个相互矛盾的信号。
① 授予者是“朋友” (Friend) → 暗示属人性。
② 用途是“餐厅经营” (Restaurant business) → 暗示商业性。
2
书面沉默：题目明确指出书面协议“未涉及可转让性”。
3
决定性因素：由于默认规则是“可转让，除非意图为属人”，因此当事人的意图 (Intent) 是决定该权利能否随餐厅出售而转让给厨师的核心因素。

因此，选项 A 正确。

干扰项排除

选项 B & C (排他性 Exclusivity)：
是否授予他人或保留自己的捕鱼权，决定了该取益权是“排他的”还是“非排他的”。这主要影响权利的可分割性 (Apportionability)（即能否将权利分给多个人使用），而不是权利本身的可转让性 (Transferability)。
选项 D (登记 Recording)：
登记法 (Recording Acts) 旨在保护购买者免受未登记权益的影响。登记与否不改变权益本身的性质（即是否为属人权）。如果该权利本质上是属人的（不可转让），登记也不会使其变得可转让。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)：
在 MBE 财产法题目中，如果遇到关于 Easement in Gross（独立地役权）或 Profit in Gross（独立取益权）的转让问题，首先判断它是商业用途还是个人用途。

如果题目对用途描述模糊（如本题既有朋友关系又有商业用途），则“当事人的意图” (Intent of the parties) 永远是最高优先级的判断标准。

questions.question:
A building with 40 residential units is owned by a corporation and operated as a cooperative. Each resident is a shareholder in the corporation as well as its tenant pursuant to a lease that is subject to the mortgage on the building. Each tenant is assessed an annual fee to cover part of the corporation's taxes, maintenance expenses, and mortgage obligation. Through poor management by the corporation's board of directors, the corporation failed to raise sufficient funds to pay the mortgage obligation. The bank that holds the mortgage on the building has begun foreclosure proceedings. A resident of the building who paid the annual assessment fee and is not a member of the board of directors has sought a declaratory judgment that a buyer at the foreclosure sale takes the building subject to her lease.
The applicable jurisdiction has not adopted a statute that addresses this situation.
How should the court rule?

choices.a: Against the resident, because she is personally liable for the mortgage obligation as a shareholder of the corporation.
choices.b: Against the resident, because the lease is subject to the mortgage on the building.
choices.c: For the resident, because she is not a member of the corporation's board of directors.
choices.d: For the resident, because she paid her annual assessment fee.

一栋拥有40个住宅单元的建筑由一家公司所有，并作为合作社（cooperative）运营。根据一份受该建筑抵押权约束的租赁合同，每位住户既是公司的股东，也是其承租人。每位承租人都被征收年度费用，以支付公司的部分税款、维护费用和抵押贷款债务。由于公司董事会管理不善，公司未能筹集到足够资金来偿付抵押贷款债务。持有该建筑抵押权的银行已启动止赎程序。一位已支付年度评估费且非董事会成员的住户，请求法院作出宣告性判决，认定止赎拍卖中的买家在购得该建筑时，须受其租赁合同的约束。

相关司法管辖区并未通过解决此种情况的法规。

法院应如何裁决？
options:
A. Against the resident, because she is personally liable for the mortgage obligation as a shareholder of the corporation.
裁决住户败诉，因为作为公司股东，她个人对抵押贷款债务承担责任。

B. Against the resident, because the lease is subject to the mortgage on the building.
裁决住户败诉，因为租赁合同受该建筑的抵押权约束。

C. For the resident, because she is not a member of the corporation's board of directors.
裁决住户胜诉，因为她不是公司董事会成员。

D. For the resident, because she paid her annual assessment fee.
裁决住户胜诉，因为她已支付其年度评估费用。
