data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：衡平法地役权

本题考察的是不动产法中关于限制性契约（Restrictive Covenants）随土地转移的规则，特别是当原告寻求禁令（Injunction）而非金钱赔偿时。

核心区分：
如果原告寻求金钱赔偿 (Money Damages) → 适用 Real Covenant (土地物权契约) 规则。
如果原告寻求禁令 (Injunction) → 适用 Equitable Servitude (衡平法地役权) 规则。

本题中，经理（Manager）寻求的是禁止朋友（Friend）经营加油站，属于禁令，因此我们必须分析衡平法地役权的要素。

负担随土地转移的要素 (Burden to Run)

要让限制性契约的负担约束后续的土地所有者（本案中的朋友），必须满足以下条件：

  • 书面形式 (Writing)：原始契约必须是书面的（本案中特许人给创业者的地契中有写）。
  • 意图 (Intent)：当事人意图让该承诺约束继承人。
  • 涉及与关乎土地 (Touch and Concern)：限制了土地的使用方式（不许建加油站），符合此项。
  • 知情 (Notice)：这是本题的关键！后续买家在购买时必须知道该限制的存在。

为什么选项 B 是正确答案？

选项 B：该朋友对施加限制的契约有实际知情 (Actual Knowledge)。

在衡平法地役权的分析中，知情 (Notice) 是决定性的因素。知情通常分为三种：

  1. 实际知情 (Actual Notice)：买家事实上知道该限制。
  2. 推定/登记知情 (Record/Constructive Notice)：契约已在公共记录中正确登记。
  3. 调查知情 (Inquiry Notice)：土地的状况或外观理应引起买家的询问。
特许人 (F) → 创业者 (E)
(契约未登记，但有书面约定)
↓
特许人 (F) → 朋友 (Fr)
(朋友实际上知道 F 和 E 的约定)

推理逻辑：

虽然包含限制性契约的地契（特许人给创业者的）没有被登记（因此没有“登记知情”），但题目明确指出朋友在交易前“知道”（knew about）这个契约。这种实际知情 (Actual Notice) 足以让衡平法法院强制执行该地役权，禁止朋友违反约定。

其他选项为何错误？

选项 A (法律支持商业限制)：错误。
恰恰相反，法律倾向于土地的自由使用，通常不鼓励（disfavor）限制性契约。法院会严格解释此类限制。
选项 C (推定知晓 Constructive Notice)：错误。
推定知晓通常源于登记系统。题目明确说明包含契约的地契未被登记 (Deed was not recorded)。因此，朋友不可能通过查阅公报获得通知。
选项 D (相互性消极契约 Negative Reciprocal Covenants)：错误。
这个原则（也称 Common Scheme Doctrine）通常用于开发商开发大型住宅区（Subdivision）时，遗漏了某些地块的限制。本案只是两个地块的简单转让，且存在明示的契约和实际知情，不需要依赖这个默示原则。
💡 MBE 考试技巧
遇到 Real Property 的题目，首先看救济方式（赔偿 vs. 禁令）。

如果是禁令，找 Notice (知情)。即使文件未登记（Record Act 陷阱），只要买家有Actual Notice (实际知情)，他就是输家。不要被“未登记”这个事实带偏，实际知情是王牌。

questions.question:
A builder purchased 10 acres of undeveloped land. He intended to construct five homes, and each home was to be constructed on a two-acre lot, which was the minimum size permitted under the zoning regulations. The builder employed an architect to design the basic plan for each home, but the builder was forced to shelve those plans due to a sudden downturn in the economy.
Six years later, the builder engaged a surveyor to subdivide the land into two-acre lots. He then discovered that the local zoning board had validly rezoned the area in which the 10 acres were located a year ago, increasing the minimum lot size to two and one-half acres for new residences. The zoning ordinance does not provide for special exceptions, and the builder cannot profitably construct only four of the five homes designed by the architect.
Can the builder proceed with his plans to build five homes on two-acre lots?

choices.a: No, because the ordinance does not provide for special exceptions.
choices.b: No, because the two and one-half acre restriction properly applies to the builder's land.
choices.c: Yes, because he cannot profitably construct only four homes on the 10 acres.
choices.d: Yes, because his rights with regard to the land vested when he purchased the land.

questions.question:
A rancher owned in fee simple two adjoining lots, Lots 1 and 2. He conveyed Lot 1 in fee simple to his cousin. The deed was in usual form of a warranty deed with the following provision inserted in the appropriate place: "Grantor, for himself, his heirs and assigns, does covenant and agree that any reasonable expense incurred by grantee, his heirs and assigns, as the result of having to repair the retaining wall presently situated on Lot 1 at the common boundary with Lot 2, shall be reimbursed one-half the costs of repairs; and by this provision the parties intend a covenant running with the land."
The cousin conveyed Lot 1 in fee simple to a woman by warranty deed in usual and regular form. The deed omitted any reference to the retaining wall or any covenant. Fifty years after the rancher's conveyance to the cousin, the woman conveyed Lot 1 in fee simple to a developer by warranty deed in usual form. This deed omitted any reference to the retaining wall or the covenant.
There is no statute that applies to any aspect of the problems presented except a recording act and a statute providing for acquisition of title after 10 years of adverse possession. The deed from the rancher to the cousin was never recorded. All other deeds were promptly and properly recorded.
Lot 2 is now owned by the rancher's daughter, who took by intestate succession. The developer expended $3,500 on the retaining wall. Then he obtained all the original deeds in the chain of title from the rancher to himself. Shortly thereafter, the developer discovered the covenant in the rancher's deed to the cousin. The developer demanded that the daughter pay $1,750. When she refused, he instituted an appropriate action to recover that sum.
If judgment is for the daughter, what will be the likely reason?

choices.a: The cousin's deed from the rancher was never recorded.
choices.b: The developer did not know about the covenant until after he had incurred the expenses and, hence, could not have relied on it.
choices.c: The developer is barred by adverse possession.
choices.d: The developer's expenditures were not proved to be reasonable and customary.

There is no statute that applies to any aspect of the problems presented except a recording act and a statute providing for acquisition of title after 10 years of adverse possession. The deed from the rancher to the cousin was never recorded. All other deeds were promptly and properly recorded.

Then he obtained all the original deeds in the chain of title from the rancher to himself. Shortly thereafter, the developer discovered the covenant in the rancher's deed to the cousin. If judgment is for the daughter, what will be the likely reason?

一位牧场主以完全保有地权（fee simple）拥有两个相邻地块，地块1和地块2。他将地块1的完全保有地权转让给了他的堂兄。该地契是一份常规形式的担保地契（warranty deed），并在适当位置插入了以下条款：“出让人，为其本人、其继承人和受让人，立约并同意，受让人、其继承人和受让人因必须修缮位于地块1与地块2公共边界上的现有挡土墙而产生的任何合理费用，应获偿还维修费用的一半；双方意图通过此条款设立一项随土地转移的契约（covenant running with the land）。”

堂兄通过一份常规形式的担保地契，将地块1的完全保有地权转让给了一位女士。该地契未提及挡土墙或任何契约。在牧场主转让给堂兄五十年后，该女士通过一份常规形式的担保地契将地块1的完全保有地权转让给了一位开发商。该地契也未提及挡土墙或该契约。

除了登记法案和一项规定经过10年侵权逆占（adverse possession）即可获得所有权的法规外，没有其他法规适用于本案所涉的任何方面。从牧场主到堂兄的地契从未被登记。所有其他地契都及时并妥当地进行了登记。

地块2现在由牧场主的女儿所有，她是通过无遗嘱继承（intestate succession）获得的。开发商在挡土墙上花费了3,500美元。然后，他获得了从牧场主到他自己这条所有权链中的所有原始地契。不久之后，开发商在牧场主给堂兄的地契中发现了该契约。开发商要求女儿支付1,750美元。当她拒绝后，他提起了适当的诉讼来追讨这笔款项。

如果判决有利于女儿，最可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. The cousin's deed from the rancher was never recorded.
牧场主给堂兄的地契从未被登记。

B. The developer did not know about the covenant until after he had incurred the expenses and, hence, could not have relied on it.
开发商在产生费用之后才知道该契约的存在，因此，他不可能依赖于该契约。

C. The developer is barred by adverse possession.
开发商受到侵权逆占（adverse possession）的禁止。

D. The developer's expenditures were not proved to be reasonable and customary.
开发商的支出未被证明是合理且惯常的。
data.explanation:
A real covenant is an express promise regarding land that is enforceable by an action for money damages. Although the promising parties can enforce the covenant under contract law, the covenant can only bind successors in interest if the benefit/burden runs with the land. This requires proof of the following elements:
  • Writing - covenant is in a writing that satisfies the statute of frauds (eg, Lot 1 deed to the cousin)
  • Intent to run - promising parties intended for the covenant to run to their successors in interest (eg, deed says "heirs and assigns" and "running with the land")
  • Touch and concern - covenant relates to the use, enjoyment, or occupation of the benefited and burdened lands (eg, shared enjoyment of retaining wall)
  • Horizontal privity - promising parties simultaneously transferred the land and created the covenant (eg, covenant was created when Lot 1 was deeded to the cousin)
  • Vertical privity - successor of the benefited estate has a possessory interest (eg, developer owns Lot 1) and successor of the burdened estate has a promising party's entire estate or ownership interest (eg, daughter has rancher's fee simple in Lot 2)
  • Notice - person to be bound had notice of the covenant if he/she purchased the property (eg, daughter inherited Lot 2, so it is irrelevant that the cousin's deed was never recorded) (Choice A)

Therefore, the daughter is bound by the covenant to pay reasonable expenses for the repairs. Judgment would likely be entered for the daughter if the developer's expenditures were not proved to be reasonable and customary.

(Choice B) Notice is not a requirement for successors in interest of land benefited by a real covenant (eg, the developer) to enforce it.

(Choice C) Persons who acquire land subject to a real covenant through adverse possession cannot enforce the covenant. But the developer acquired Lot 1 by deed - not through adverse possession.

Educational objective: A real covenant will only bind successors in interest if the following elements are met: (1) writing, (2) intent to run, (3) touch and concern, (4) horizontal privity, (5) vertical privity, and (6) notice.



选项正确率统计：A选项 50%，B选项 28%，C选项 4%，D选项 17%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

地产契约（real covenant）是一项关于土地的明确承诺，可通过金钱损害赔偿诉讼来强制执行。尽管立约方可以根据合同法强制执行该契约，但只有当利益/负担随土地转移（runs with the land）时，该契约才能约束权益继承人（successors in interest）。这需要证明以下要素：
  • 书面形式 - 契约以书面形式存在，且满足反欺诈法（statute of frauds）的要求（例如，地块1给堂兄的地契）
  • 转移意图 - 立约方意图让契约对其权益继承人继续有效（例如，地契中写有“继承人和受让人”以及“随土地转移”）
  • 涉及和关系（Touch and concern） - 契约与受益和受负土地的使用、享用或占用有关（例如，共同享用挡土墙）
  • 横向关联（Horizontal privity） - 立约方在转让土地的同时设立了该契约（例如，契约在地块1转让给堂兄时设立）
  • 纵向关联（Vertical privity） - 受益地产的继承人拥有占有权益（例如，开发商拥有地块1），且受负地产的继承人拥有立约方的全部地产或所有权权益（例如，女儿拥有牧场主在地块2的完全保有地权）
  • 通知 - 如果受约束方是购买了该地产，则其必须已被告知该契约的存在（例如，女儿是继承了地块2，因此堂兄的地契是否登记过是无关紧要的） （选项A）

因此，女儿受该契约的约束，应支付合理的维修费用。如果开发商的支出未被证明是合理且惯常的，那么判决很可能会有利于女儿。

（选项B） 对于地产契约的受益土地的权益继承人（例如，开发商）而言，通知并非其强制执行契约的必要条件。

（选项C） 通过侵权逆占获得受地产契约约束的土地的人不能强制执行该契约。但开发商是通过地契而非侵权逆占获得地块1的。

教学目标： 一项地产契约只有在满足以下要素时才能约束权益继承人：（1）书面形式，（2）转移意图，（3）涉及和关系，（4）横向关联，（5）纵向关联，以及（6）通知。

References

Restatement of Property §§ 530 - 38 (Am. Law Inst. 1944) (elements of real covenants).

MBE 考点解析

Real Covenants & Recording Acts

核心考点：地产契约 (Real Covenant)

本题考察的是地产契约中的负担随土地转移 (Burden Running with the Land) 的条件。要让牧场主的继承人（女儿）承担付款义务，必须满足以下要素（记忆口诀 WITHN）：

  • Writing (书面形式)
  • Intent (转移意图)
  • Touch & Concern (涉及土地权益)
  • Horizontal & Vertical Privity (横向与纵向关联)
  • Notice (通知/知情)
案情梳理
地块 1 (受益方)
牧场主 (Rancher)
↓ 担保地契 (未登记)
堂兄 (Cousin)
↓
女士 (Woman)
↓
开发商 (Developer)
(原告)
地块 2 (受负方)
牧场主 (Rancher)
↓ 无遗嘱继承



女儿 (Daughter)
(被告)
⚠️ 为什么选项 A 是最大的陷阱？

选项 A 称“牧场主给堂兄的地契从未登记”。很多考生看到“未登记”就会联想到登记法案 (Recording Acts)，认为未登记导致契约无效。

关键点：登记法案只保护有偿购买者 (Purchasers for value)。本题中，女儿是通过无遗嘱继承 (Intestate Succession) 获得地块 2 的。

继承人不是购买者，不受登记法案保护。她只是站在了牧场主的位置上（step into the shoes），无论她是否知情，只要契约有效，她就必须继承该负担。

✅ 正确答案：D

“开发商的支出未被证明是合理且惯常的。”

法律推理：

  1. 契约有效且随土地转移： 所有的 WITHN 要素都满足。
    • 书面、意图、涉及土地均无争议。
    • 关联性 (Privity) 存在。
    • 通知 (Notice) 对继承人不是抗辩理由（见上文）。
  2. 回归合同条款： 既然契约对女儿有约束力，我们必须看契约的具体内容。条款明确规定："...any reasonable expense... shall be reimbursed..."（任何合理的费用……应获偿还）。
  3. 事实抗辩： 如果开发商花费了 $3,500，但无法证明这是“合理的 (reasonable)”或“惯常的 (customary)”，那么根据契约本身的条款，女儿就没有义务支付这笔钱。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

当题目问“如果被告胜诉，理由是什么”时：

  1. 首先检查法律原则（如：契约是否随土地转移？）。
  2. 如果法律原则上被告应当承担责任（如本题中女儿无法通过Recording Act免责），那么请仔细检查事实细节或合同条款。
  3. 本题是一个典型的“法律上成立，但事实上失败”的例子。不要忽略题目中引用的具体合同措辞（"reasonable expense"）。

questions.question:
A man owned a lakefront home in a gated community with a pier where he docked his boat. His neighbor, whose home did not have a pier, told him that she was interested in purchasing a boat but that she had nowhere to dock it except for the community clubhouse. The clubhouse was located at the other end of the gated community far from the neighbor's home. However, the man told the neighbor that she could use his pier to dock her boat, and as a result, the neighbor purchased a boat knowing that she could dock it close to home. For the next 11 years, the neighbor used the man's pier to dock her boat. During this time, the neighbor also paid for the pier to be rebuilt due to corrosion. Thereafter, the man told the neighbor that she could only use the pier if she paid a monthly fee of $600. When the neighbor refused to pay the fee, the man built a fence around the pier and refused to give the neighbor a key to unlock the fence.
The statutory period for acquiring rights by prescription in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
Does the neighbor have the right to use the man's pier to dock her boat?

choices.a: No, because the easement was not in a writing that satisfied the statute of frauds.
choices.b: No, because the neighbor could have docked her boat at the community clubhouse.
choices.c: Yes, because the neighbor detrimentally relied on the man's permission to use the pier.
choices.d: Yes, because the neighbor's use of the pier was continuous, actual, and open.

However, the man told the neighbor that she could use his pier to dock her boat, and as a result, the neighbor purchased a boat knowing that she could dock it close to home. For the next 11 years, the neighbor used the man's pier to dock her boat. During this time, the neighbor also paid for the pier to be rebuilt due to corrosion. Thereafter, the man told the neighbor that she could only use the pier if she paid a monthly fee of $600. When the neighbor refused to pay the fee, the man built a fence around the pier and refused to give the neighbor a key to unlock the fence.

The statutory period for acquiring rights by prescription in the jurisdiction is 10 years.

Does the neighbor have the right to use the man's pier to dock her boat?

一名男子在一个封闭式社区拥有一栋湖滨住宅，住宅带有一个码头，他用该码头停泊他的船。他的邻居的住宅没有码头，她告诉该男子她有兴趣购买一艘船，但除了社区会所外，她没有地方停泊。该会所位于封闭式社区的另一端，远离邻居的家。然而，该男子告诉邻居她可以使用他的码头来停泊她的船，因此，邻居在知道她可以把船停在离家近的地方后，购买了一艘船。在接下来的11年里，邻居一直使用该男子的码头停泊她的船。在此期间，邻居还因码头腐蚀而出资重建。此后，该男子告诉邻居，她只有在每月支付600美元费用的情况下才能使用该码头。当邻居拒绝支付费用时，该男子在码头周围建了一个栅栏，并拒绝给邻居打开栅栏的钥匙。

在该司法管辖区，通过时效取得权利的法定期限是10年。

邻居是否有权使用该男子的码头来停泊她的船？
options:
A. No, because the easement was not in a writing that satisfied the statute of frauds.
不成立，因为该地役权没有满足《防止欺诈法》(statute of frauds) 的书面形式要求。

B. No, because the neighbor could have docked her boat at the community clubhouse.
不成立，因为邻居本可以将其船停泊在社区会所。

C. Yes, because the neighbor detrimentally relied on the man's permission to use the pier.
成立，因为邻居因信赖该男子的许可而使用了码头，并因此蒙受了不利。

D. Yes, because the neighbor's use of the pier was continuous, actual, and open.
成立，因为邻居对码头的使用是持续的、实际的和公开的。
data.explanation:
Distinctions between easements


TypeAppurtenantBenefits easement holder's land
Benefit & burden automatically transfer when land is conveyed
In grossBenefits easement holder personally
Burden (not benefit) automatically transfers when land is conveyed
PurposeAffirmativeAllows easement holder to do something on servient estate
NegativeRestricts servient-estate owner's lawful use of servient estate
CreationExpressCreated by parties in writing that satisfies statute of frauds
Irrevocable licenseLicense becomes irrevocable due to estoppel or coupling with another servitude
ImpliedImplied by law due to necessity (easement by necessity)
Implied by fact due to prior use (easement by implication)
By prescriptionAdversely acquired through OCAN - open/notorious, actual, continuous & nonpermissive use
An easement is a right held by one person to make specific, limited use of land owned by another. The land that is subject to the easement is the servient estate, while the land that benefits from the easement is the dominant estate.

Most easements are expressly created in a writing that satisfies the statute of frauds, but they also can be created by other methods - including estoppel. An easement by estoppel arises from good-faith, reasonable, detrimental reliance on the servient-estate owner's permission to make a limited use of his/her land.†

Here, the man (servient-estate owner) gave the neighbor (dominant-estate owner) permission to use his pier to dock her boat. The neighbor reasonably relied on that permission to her detriment by purchasing a boat, having no reason to believe that the permission would be revoked. She even paid for the man's pier to be rebuilt due to corrosion. Therefore, the neighbor obtained an easement by estoppel, giving her the right to use the man's pier.

†An easement by estoppel can also be characterized as an irrevocable license.

(Choice A) While a valid easement can be expressly created by a writing that satisfies the statute of frauds, it can also be created by other means (here, by estoppel).

(Choice B) The neighbor's ability to dock her boat at the community clubhouse has no bearing on her right to use the man's pier. Although she would be inconvenienced if she had to use the community clubhouse, this does not create an easement by necessity on the man's pier. Such an easement can be implied only when property is rendered virtually useless (typically from being landlocked) without an easement across the neighboring property.

(Choices D) Although the neighbor openly and continuously used the pier for more than the 10-year statutory period, that use was with the man's permission. This negates the hostile (nonpermissive) use required to establish an easement by prescription.

Educational objective: An easement by estoppel is created through good-faith, reasonable, detrimental reliance on the servient-estate owner's permission to make a limited use of his/her land.

选项正确率统计：A选项 17%，B选项 10%，C选项 49%（正确选项），D选项 23%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

地役权的区分


类型Appurtenant (从属地役权)为地役权持有人的土地带来利益
当土地转让时，利益与负担自动转移
In gross (对人地役权)为地役权持有人个人带来利益
当土地转让时，负担（而非利益）自动转移
目的Affirmative (积极地役权)允许地役权持有人在供役地上进行特定行为
Negative (消极地役权)限制供役地所有权人对供役地的合法使用
设立方式Express (明示设立)由当事方以满足《防止欺诈法》(statute of frauds) 的书面形式设立
Irrevocable license (不可撤销的许可)由于禁反言或与另一役权结合，许可变为不可撤销
Implied (默示设立)因必要性而由法律推定（easement by necessity - 必要地役权）
因先前使用而由事实推定（easement by implication - 默示地役权）
By prescription (时效取得)通过OCAN（open/notorious - 公开/众所周知，actual - 实际，continuous - 持续，及nonpermissive - 未经许可）的侵权性使用而取得
地役权 (easement) 是一方为特定、有限的目的而使用他人土地的权利。受地役权限制的土地称为供役地 (servient estate)，而从地役权中受益的土地称为需役地 (dominant estate)。

大多数地役权是通过满足《防止欺诈法》(statute of frauds) 的书面形式明示设立的，但也可以通过其他方式设立——包括禁反言 (estoppel)。禁反言地役权 (easement by estoppel) 源于对供役地所有权人许可其有限使用其土地的善意、合理、不利的信赖。†

在本案中，该男子（供役地所有权人）准许邻居（需役地所有权人）使用其码头停泊船只。邻居合理地信赖了该许可，并购买了一艘船，从而蒙受了不利，她没有理由相信该许可会被撤销。她甚至因码头腐蚀而出资重建。因此，邻居通过禁反言 (estoppel) 获得了地役权，使其有权使用该男子的码头。

†禁反言地役权 (easement by estoppel) 也可被定性为不可撤销的许可 (irrevocable license)。

(选项 A) 尽管有效的地役权可以通过满足《防止欺诈法》(statute of frauds) 的书面形式明示设立，但它也可以通过其他方式（本案中为禁反言）设立。

(选项 B) 邻居能否在社区会所停泊船只，与她使用该男子码头的权利无关。尽管如果她必须使用社区会所会带来不便，但这并不构成在该男子码头上的必要地役权 (easement by necessity)。只有当一块地产若无邻近地产的地役权便几乎无法使用时（通常指土地被完全封闭的情况），才可以推定此类地役权的存在。

(选项 D) 尽管邻居公开并持续使用码头超过了10年的法定期限，但她的使用是经过该男子许可的。这否定了通过时效取得地役权 (easement by prescription) 所需的敌意（未经许可）使用这一要件。

教学目标：禁反言地役权 (easement by estoppel) 是通过对供役地所有权人准许其有限使用其土地的善意、合理、不利的信赖而设立的。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 2.10 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (servitudes created by estoppel).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Easements & Licenses

核心考点：禁反言地役权 Easement by Estoppel / Irrevocable License

通常情况下，许可（License）是可撤销的。但如果被许可人基于对许可的合理信赖（Reasonable Reliance），投入了大量资金或劳力（Detriment），该许可就会变为不可撤销，从而形成禁反言地役权。

案情逻辑链条
  • 许可 (Permission)：男子口头允许邻居使用码头。
  • 信赖 (Reliance)：邻居基于此许可购买了船只。
  • 投入/不利 (Detriment)：邻居不仅买了船，还出资重建了被腐蚀的码头。
  • 结果：许可变为不可撤销。

因此，正确答案是 选项 C。

陷阱选项排除
❌ 选项 A：防止欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds)

虽然地役权通常需要书面形式，但禁反言 (Estoppel) 是《防止欺诈法》的重要例外。当存在不利信赖时，无需书面文件即可成立地役权。

❌ 选项 B：必要性 (Necessity)

只有当土地完全无法使用（如“袋地” landlocked）时才适用必要地役权 (Easement by Necessity)。仅仅是因为“方便”或“不想去远处的会所”不足以构成法律上的必要性。

❌ 选项 D：时效取得 (Prescription)

这是一个经典的干扰项。虽然使用了11年（超过10年时效），但时效取得必须是敌意的 (Hostile/Adverse)。本案中邻居的使用是经过男子许可 (Permission) 的，许可直接否定了敌意，因此无法通过时效取得权利。

💡 MBE 考试技巧
当你看到题目中出现：
1. 口头允许 (Oral Permission)
2. 随后有一方投入金钱或劳力 (Investment of money/labor)

请立即联想 Irrevocable License 或 Easement by Estoppel。不要被“没有书面合同”或“时效期限”迷惑。

questions.question:
The existence of an express right-of-way easement over land was discovered during a title search conducted by an individual who had contracted to buy the land. The seller desired to secure a release of the easement, so he traveled to the easement holder's neighboring property. When the seller arrived, the neighbor's adult daughter informed him that the neighbor had been living in a nursing home for the past year and that she had been taking care of his land. In exchange for a small sum, the neighbor's daughter executed the requested document. The document stated that the neighbor "hereby releases" the easement over the seller's land, which was described in full.
The seller then deeded the land to the buyer, and the neighbor died shortly thereafter. The neighbor's property passed by will to the neighbor's daughter. The daughter claims that she continues to possess a right-of-way easement over the buyer's land.
Is the neighbor's daughter correct?

choices.a: No, because the daughter signed the release of the easement.
choices.b: No, because the release was valid and terminated the easement.
choices.c: Yes, because the property interest was not a license and did not expire upon the neighbor's death.
choices.d: Yes, because the release was not signed by the neighbor and violated the statute of frauds.

Q86174

The existence of an express right-of-way easement over land was discovered during a title search conducted by an individual who had contracted to buy the land. The seller desired to secure a release of the easement, so he traveled to the easement holder's neighboring property. When the seller arrived, the neighbor's adult daughter informed him that the neighbor had been living in a nursing home for the past year and that she had been taking care of his land. In exchange for a small sum, the neighbor's daughter executed the requested document. The document stated that the neighbor "hereby releases" the easement over the seller's land, which was described in full.

The seller then deeded the land to the buyer, and the neighbor died shortly thereafter. The neighbor's property passed by will to the neighbor's daughter. The daughter claims that she continues to possess a right-of-way easement over the buyer's land.

Is the neighbor's daughter correct?

在一项由土地购买合同的当事人进行的产权调查中，发现土地上存在一项明示的通行地役权。卖方希望获得该地役权的弃权书，因此他前往地役权持有人的邻近地产。当卖方到达时，邻居的成年女儿告知他，邻居在过去一年里一直住在养老院，而她一直在照管他的土地。为了换取一小笔钱，邻居的女儿签署了所要求的文件。该文件声明，邻居“在此放弃”其在卖方土地上的地役权，并对该地役权进行了完整描述。

随后，卖方将土地通过契约转让给买方，邻居不久后去世。邻居的财产通过遗嘱传给了他的女儿。女儿声称她继续拥有在买方土地上的通行地役权。

邻居的女儿是否正确？
options:
A. No, because the daughter signed the release of the easement.
不正确，因为女儿签署了地役权的弃权书。

B. No, because the release was valid and terminated the easement.
不正确，因为弃权书有效并终止了该地役权。

C. Yes, because the property interest was not a license and did not expire upon the neighbor's death.
正确，因为该财产权益不是一项许可，并未因邻居的死亡而失效。

D. Yes, because the release was not signed by the neighbor and violated the statute of frauds.
正确，因为弃权书未经邻居本人签署，并且违反了防止欺诈法。
data.explanation:
Ways to terminate easements


Destructionservient estate condemned or destroyed by natural forces
Abandonmentdominant estate abandons easement
Mergerdominant & servient estates united in common ownership
Prescriptionservient owner prevents use for prescriptive period
Estoppeldominant owner estopped from asserting easement
Releaseexpress release in writing satisfying statute of frauds
Mnemonic: DAMPER

An easement is a nonpossessory interest in someone else's land that gives the easement holder the right to enter and use the land for a specific purpose. An easement can be terminated by a release - ie, a writing that expressly relinquishes the easement right - so long as it complies with the statute of frauds. To comply with the statute of frauds, the writing must do the following:

  • Reasonably identify the parties (the neighbor and the seller)
  • Contain words of transfer ("hereby releases")
  • Describe the nature of the easement (the easement over the seller's land was described in full)
  • Be signed by the easement holder (the neighbor)


Since the neighbor did not sign the release (the daughter did), the document secured by the seller was not a valid release that terminated the easement (Choices B & D). But since the daughter did sign the release, she will be estopped from asserting that she inherited the neighbor's right-of-way over the buyer's land.

(Choice C) Although a license typically expires upon the death of the licensee, an easement does not expire upon the death of the easement holder. This means that the neighbor's easement passed by will to his daughter. However, she will be estopped from asserting the easement's validity because she signed the release.

Educational objective: An easement can be terminated by a written release that complies with the statute of frauds. To do so, the release must (1) reasonably identify the parties, (2) contain words of transfer, (3) describe the nature of the easement, and (4) be signed by the easement holder.

选项正确率统计：A选项 36%（正确选项），B选项 26%，C选项 4%，D选项 32%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

终止地役权的方式


Destruction (毁损)供役地被征收或因自然力量被毁
Abandonment (放弃)需役地所有人放弃地役权
Merger (混同)需役地和供役地合并为同一人所有
Prescription (时效)供役地所有人在法定时效期间内阻止使用
Estoppel (禁止反言)需役地所有人因禁止反言原则不得主张地役权
Release (弃权)满足防止欺诈法的书面明示弃权
助记词: DAMPER

地役权 (easement) 是一种在他人土地上的非占有性权益，它赋予地役权持有人为特定目的进入和使用该土地的权利。地役权可以通过弃权书 (release) 终止——即一份明示放弃地役权权利的书面文件——只要它符合防止欺诈法 (statute of frauds) 的要求。为符合防止欺诈法，该书面文件必须满足以下条件：

  • 合理确定当事人（邻居和卖方）
  • 包含弃权词语（“在此放弃”）
  • 描述地役权的性质（对卖方土地上的地役权有完整描述）
  • 由地役权持有人（邻居）签署


由于邻居没有签署弃权书（是女儿签署的），卖方获得的文件并非一份终止该地役权的有效弃权书（选项 B & D）。但由于女儿确实签署了弃权书，她将被禁止反言 (estopped)，不得主张她继承了邻居在买方土地上的通行权。

（选项 C）尽管一项许可 (license) 通常在被许可人死亡时失效，但地役权不会因地役权持有人的死亡而失效。这意味着邻居的地役权通过遗嘱传给了他的女儿。然而，由于她签署了弃权书，她将被禁止反言，不得主张该地役权的有效性。

教学目标：地役权可以通过一份符合防止欺诈法的书面弃权书来终止。为此，该弃权书必须 (1) 合理确定当事人，(2) 包含弃权词语，(3) 描述地役权的性质，以及 (4) 由地役权持有人签署。

References

  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 7.3 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (termination of an easement by release).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Easements & Estoppel
正确答案：A

不正确，因为女儿签署了地役权的弃权书 (Release)。

本题考察的是地役权的终止 (Termination of Easements) 与禁止反言 (Estoppel) 原则的交叉应用。

1. 防止欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds)

地役权 (Easement) 是土地权益。根据防止欺诈法，终止地役权的弃权书 (Release) 必须由地役权持有人 (Easement Holder) 签署才有效。

在本案中，签署弃权书时，邻居（父亲）还活着，他才是地役权持有人。女儿当时并没有所有权。因此，从技术上讲，这份弃权书在当时是无效的。

2. 禁止反言 (Estoppel)

这是本题的解题关键。虽然弃权书最初因签署人无权处分而无效，但情况发生了变化：

  • 女儿继承了土地，成为了真正的地役权持有人。
  • 女儿之前亲自签署了弃权书并接受了对价（钱）。

法律原则是：如果一个人声称放弃某项权利（即使当时她没有该权利），当她后来真正获得该权利时，她被“禁止反言” (Estopped)，即不能推翻自己之前的声明。

因此，女儿不能现在跳出来说：“嘿，我签字的时候这地不是我的，所以那个签字不算数，我现在要行使地役权。”

为什么排除其他选项？
选项 B 错误： 它声称弃权书是“有效的” (Valid)。这是不准确的法律表述。弃权书本身因违反防止欺诈法（非权利人签署）在当时是无效的。女儿无法行使权利是因为个人被禁止 (Personal Estoppel)，而不是因为文件本身完美无瑕。
选项 D 错误： 这是一个典型的“陷阱选项”。它正确地指出了弃权书违反了防止欺诈法（未由邻居签署）。但是，它忽略了禁止反言这一衡平法原则 (Equitable Doctrine)。在MBE中，如果一方的不当行为或承诺导致了不公平的结果，衡平法通常会介入。
选项 C 错误： 虽然地役权确实通常会通过遗嘱传递（不像许可 License 那样随死亡终止），但这里的关键阻碍是女儿自己的签字行为，而非继承规则。
💡 考试锦囊：DAMPER

地役权终止的六种方式

Destruction (毁损)
Abandonment (放弃)
Merger (混同)
Prescription (时效)
Estoppel (禁止反言) ✅
Release (书面弃权)

本题结合了 Release（形式要件未满足）和 Estoppel（最终结果）。

questions.question:
A landlord orally leased a commercial building to a tenant for a 10-year term, which ended one year ago. At the beginning of the lease term, the tenant installed numerous appliances in the building as well as a large air-conditioning system. The tenant alone paid for these items; they were installed with the landlord's permission and were used for the tenant's commercial enterprise.
At the end of the lease term, the tenant failed to vacate the premises in a timely manner and continued to pay rent while remaining in possession for another four months. Before vacating the building at the end of the fourth month, the tenant removed the appliances and the air-conditioning system that he had installed, causing no damage to the building.
Was the removal by the tenant proper?

choices.a: No, because he was a holdover tenant.
choices.b: No, because the lease was oral.
choices.c: Yes, because they were accessions.
choices.d: Yes, because they were trade fixtures.

Q86827 A landlord orally leased a commercial building to a tenant for a 10-year term, which ended one year ago. At the beginning of the lease term, the tenant installed numerous appliances in the building as well as a large air-conditioning system. The tenant alone paid for these items; they were installed with the landlord's permission and were used for the tenant's commercial enterprise.

At the end of the lease term, the tenant failed to vacate the premises in a timely manner and continued to pay rent while remaining in possession for another four months. Before vacating the building at the end of the fourth month, the tenant removed the appliances and the air-conditioning system that he had installed, causing no damage to the building.

Was the removal by the tenant proper? 房东将一栋商业建筑口头出租给租户，租期为10年，该租期已于一年前结束。在租期开始时，租户在建筑物内安装了许多电器以及一个大型空调系统。这些物品由租户单独支付费用；它们是在房东的许可下安装的，并用于租户的商业企业。

在租期结束时，租户未能及时腾空房产，并继续支付租金，同时又占有了四个月。在第四个月末腾空建筑物之前，租户拆除了他安装的电器和空调系统，没有对建筑物造成任何损坏。

租户的拆除行为是否适当？
options:
A. No, because he was a holdover tenant.
不适当，因为他是一个逾期占用租户。

B. No, because the lease was oral.
不适当，因为租约是口头的。

C. Yes, because they were accessions.
适当，因为它们是添附物。

D. Yes, because they were trade fixtures.
适当，因为它们是营业定着物。
data.explanation:
A tenant can remove trade fixtures—items the tenant attached to real property for use in his/her trade or business—without the landlord's consent if:
the removal will not substantially harm the property (eg, will not degrade the building's structural integrity) and
the items are removed before, or within a reasonable time after, the lease terminates.

Since a periodic tenancy has no defined end date, it continues until either the landlord or tenant gives express notice to terminate it. This tenancy can be created by agreement (eg, a written lease) or by implication (eg, when the tenant continues to pay, and the landlord continues to accept, rent after a prior lease has ended).

Here, the appliances and air-conditioning system are trade fixtures since the tenant installed them for use in his commercial enterprise. And though the tenant's oral 10-year lease ended one year ago, he then initiated a periodic tenancy by continuing to use the premises and pay rent for another four months. And since the tenant removed the trade fixtures before the end of the fourth month (before the tenancy terminated) and caused no damage to the building, the removal was proper.

(Choice A) Although he was a holdover tenant—a tenant who entered a valid lease and then stayed past the end of the lease term—he became a periodic tenant when he kept possession of the premises and continued to pay rent. Therefore, he had the right to remove the trade fixtures before the periodic tenancy ended.

(Choice B) Since the 10-year lease was oral and could not be performed within a year, it was unenforceable under the statute of frauds. But the landlord and tenant then formed a periodic tenancy that (1) was not subject to the statute of frauds and (2) was still in effect when the tenant removed the trade fixtures. Therefore, the removal was proper (regardless of the prior oral lease).

(Choice C) Accessions are items that are so attached to other property that they cannot be removed without causing substantial damage. Here, the appliances and air-conditioning system were not accessions since they were removed without damaging the building. But had they been accessions, removal would have been improper.

Educational objective: Trade fixtures—items attached to real property by a tenant for use in his/her trade or business—can be removed without the landlord's consent if (1) the removal occurs before, or within a reasonable time after, the lease ends and (2) the removal will not substantially harm the property.



租户可以在未经房东同意的情况下拆除营业定着物（trade fixtures）——即租户为用于其行业或业务而附着在不动产上的物品——如果：
拆除不会对房产造成重大损害（例如，不会降低建筑物的结构完整性）并且
这些物品是在租约终止之前或终止后的合理时间内拆除的。

由于不定期租赁（periodic tenancy）没有明确的结束日期，它会持续到房东或租户发出明确通知终止为止。这种租赁关系可以通过协议（例如，书面租约）或默示（例如，在先前租约结束后，租户继续支付租金且房东继续接受）来建立。

在本案中，电器和空调系统是营业定着物，因为租户是为用于其商业企业而安装的。尽管租户的口头10年租约已于一年前结束，但他通过继续使用该房产并再支付四个月的租金，从而开始了一段不定期租赁。由于租户在第四个月结束前（即租赁关系终止前）拆除了营业定着物，并且没有对建筑物造成损坏，因此该拆除行为是适当的。

(选项A) 尽管他是一个逾期占用租户（holdover tenant）——即签订了有效租约，但在租期结束后仍滞留的租户——但当他继续占有房产并继续支付租金时，他就成为了一名不定期租户。因此，他有权在不定期租赁结束前拆除营业定着物。

(选项B) 由于10年租约是口头的，且无法在一年内履行完毕，根据反欺诈法（statute of frauds），该租约是不可执行的。但是，房东和租户随后形成了一种不定期租赁关系，该关系（1）不受反欺诈法的约束，并且（2）在租户拆除营业定着物时仍然有效。因此，无论先前的口头租约如何，该拆除行为都是适当的。

(选项C) 添附物（Accessions）是指与其它财产紧密附着，以至于不造成重大损害就无法拆除的物品。在本案中，电器和空调系统不是添附物，因为它们在拆除时没有损坏建筑物。但如果它们是添附物，那么拆除行为就是不适当的。

教学目标： 营业定着物——由租户为用于其行业或业务而附着在不动产上的物品——可以在未经房东同意的情况下拆除，条件是（1）拆除发生在租约结束前或结束后的合理时间内，并且（2）拆除不会对房产造成重大损害。

References

Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant § 1.5 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (periodic tenancy).

Restatement (Second) of Prop.: Landlord & Tenant §§ 12.2-12.3 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (restoration after removal of trade fixtures).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Landlord & Tenant
正确答案：D

是的，因为它们是营业定着物 (Trade Fixtures)。

核心概念：营业定着物 (Trade Fixtures)

在普通法下，一般规则是附着在土地上的物品成为不动产的一部分（Fixtures），租户不得带走。但是，针对商业租赁有一个重要的例外：

  • 定义：租户为了进行商业活动（Trade or Business）而安装的设备或物品。
  • 规则：商业租户有权在租期结束前拆除这些物品。
  • 限制条件：
    1. 拆除必须发生在租期结束前（或结束后的合理时间内）；
    2. 拆除不得对房产造成实质性损害（Substantial Harm）。

在本题中，租户安装空调和电器是为了商业用途，且拆除未造成损坏，因此符合 Trade Fixtures 的定义。

难点分析：逾期占用 (Holdover Doctrine)

很多考生会困惑：“租约不是一年前就结束了吗？为什么现在还能拆？”

这里的关键在于租户的身份转变：

  • 逾期占用 (Holdover)：租期结束后，租户未搬走。
  • 周期性租赁 (Periodic Tenancy) 的形成：当逾期租户继续支付租金，且房东接受租金时，法律上这就转化为一个新的周期性租赁（通常是按月租赁）。

结论：虽然最初的10年租约结束了，但双方建立了一个新的、有效的租赁关系。租户在第四个月末搬走前拆除物品，仍然是在“当前租赁关系存续期间”进行的，因此拆除是合法的。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (Holdover Tenant):
虽然他确实曾是逾期占用者，但一旦房东接受租金，他就变成了合法的周期性租户（Periodic Tenant），拥有完整的租户权利，包括拆除营业定着物的权利。
选项 B (Oral Lease):
虽然10年口头租约违反了《反欺诈法》(Statute of Frauds)，但这与当前的拆除权无关。当前的租赁关系是基于双方行为（占有+付租）形成的周期性租赁，这是有效的。
选项 C (Accessions):
添附物 (Accessions) 通常指与不动产结合紧密、无法在不造成破坏的情况下分离的物品。如果它们是 Accessions，租户反而不能拆除。题目明确说“未造成损坏”，所以这个理由不成立。
MBE 考试技巧

遇到商业租赁 (Commercial Lease) 的题目，看到租户安装了昂贵的设备（如冷库、柜台、机器），首先反应应该是 Trade Fixtures Doctrine。

判定的核心是：Commercial Purpose（商业目的） + No Substantial Damage（无重大损害）。只要满足这两点，普通法倾向于允许租户带走这些财产。

questions.question:
A man conveyed his house to his wife for life, remainder to his only child, a son by a previous marriage. Thereafter, the man died, devising his entire estate to his son.
The wife later removed a light fixture in the dining room of the house and replaced it with a chandelier that was one of her family heirlooms. She then informed her nephew and her late husband's son that after her death, the chandelier should be removed from the dining room and replaced with the former light fixture, which she had stored in the basement.
The wife died and under her will bequeathed her entire estate to her nephew. She also named the nephew as the personal representative of her estate. After the nephew, in his capacity as personal representative, removed the chandelier and replaced it with the original light fixture shortly after the wife's death, the son sued to have the chandelier reinstalled.
Who will likely prevail?

choices.a: The nephew, because he had the right to remove the chandelier within a reasonable time after the wife's death.
choices.b: The nephew, because of the doctrine of accession.
choices.c: The son, because a personal representative can remove only trade fixtures from real property.
choices.d: The son, because the chandelier could not be legally removed after the death of the wife.

Q86154

A man conveyed his house to his wife for life, remainder to his only child, a son by a previous marriage. Thereafter, the man died, devising his entire estate to his son.

The wife later removed a light fixture in the dining room of the house and replaced it with a chandelier that was one of her family heirlooms. She then informed her nephew and her late husband's son that after her death, the chandelier should be removed from the dining room and replaced with the former light fixture, which she had stored in the basement.

The wife died and under her will bequeathed her entire estate to her nephew. She also named the nephew as the personal representative of her estate. After the nephew, in his capacity as personal representative, removed the chandelier and replaced it with the original light fixture shortly after the wife's death, the son sued to have the chandelier reinstalled.

Who will likely prevail?

一名男子将其房屋转让给其妻子，授予其终身保有权，剩余权益归其前次婚姻所生的独子。此后，该男子去世，并通过遗嘱将其全部遗产赠与其子。

后来，该妻子移除了房屋餐厅的一盏灯具，并换上了一件作为其家族传家宝的水晶吊灯。随后，她告知其外甥和已故丈夫的儿子，在她去世后，应将该水晶吊灯从餐厅移除，并换回她存放在地下室的原有灯具。

该妻子去世，并根据其遗嘱，将其全部遗产遗赠给其外甥。她还指定其外甥为其遗产的个人代表。在妻子去世后不久，其外甥以个人代表的身份移除了水晶吊灯并换回了原来的灯具，其后，儿子提起诉讼，要求重新安装该水晶吊灯。

谁可能胜诉？
options:
A. The nephew, because he had the right to remove the chandelier within a reasonable time after the wife's death.
外甥，因为他有权在妻子去世后的合理时间内移除该水晶吊灯。

B. The nephew, because of the doctrine of accession.
外甥，因为添附原则。

C. The son, because a personal representative can remove only trade fixtures from real property.
儿子，因为个人代表只能从不动产上移除营业定着物。

D. The son, because the chandelier could not be legally removed after the death of the wife.
儿子，因为在妻子去世后，该水晶吊灯不能被合法移除。
data.explanation:
When a life tenant, the holder of a life estate, annexes (ie, attaches) a chattel to the property, the life tenant - or his/her personal representative - has the right to remove the chattel within a reasonable time after the estate ends if:
  • the life tenant did not intend for the annexation to be permanent and
  • the chattel can be removed without substantial damage to the property or the chattel.


Here, the man conveyed a life estate in the house to his wife (life tenant), who installed a chandelier (chattel) in the dining room. The wife did not intend to permanently annex the chandelier because she said it should be removed after her death. Additionally, there is no evidence that its removal caused any damage. Therefore, the nephew (the wife's personal representative) had the right to remove the chandelier within a reasonable time after her death (the termination of her life estate).

(Choice B) Under the doctrine of accession, ownership of an annexed chattel passes to the real property owner when the chattel cannot be removed without causing substantial damage. This doctrine does not apply here because the chandelier can likely be removed without causing damage. But if this doctrine did apply, then the son - not the nephew - would prevail.

(Choice C) The right to remove a chattel when a life estate ends is not limited to trade fixtures (chattels installed for use in the tenant's trade or business - eg, store display counters, restaurant equipment).

(Choice D) As the wife's personal representative, the nephew could legally remove the chandelier within a reasonable time after her death.

Educational objective: A life tenant (or his/her personal representative) may remove an annexed chattel within a reasonable time after the life estate ends if:
  • the life tenant did not intend to permanently annex the chattel and
  • its removal will not cause substantial damage.




选项正确率统计：A选项 78%（正确选项），B选项 7%，C选项 3%，D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当终身保有人，即终身地产权的持有人，将一个动产添附（即附着）到该地产上时，如果满足以下条件，该终身保有人或其个人代表有权在该地产权终止后的合理时间内移除该动产：
  • 终身保有人无意将该添附变为永久性的，并且
  • 该动产的移除不会对地产或动产本身造成实质性损害。


在本案中，该男子将其房屋的终身地产权转让给其妻子（终身保有人），妻子在餐厅安装了一盏水晶吊灯（动产）。该妻子无意永久性地添附该水晶吊灯，因为她曾表示在她去世后应将其移除。此外，没有证据表明其移除造成了任何损害。因此，外甥（妻子的个人代表）有权在其去世后（即其终身地产权终止后）的合理时间内移除该水晶吊灯。

(选项 B) 根据添附原则 (doctrine of accession)，当一个被添附的动产在移除时会对不动产造成实质性损害时，其所有权转移给该不动产的所有人。该原则在此不适用，因为该水晶吊灯很可能在移除时不会造成损害。但如果该原则适用，那么胜诉的将是儿子，而非外甥。

(选项 C) 当终身地产权终止时，移除动产的权利不限于营业定着物（为租户的贸易或业务使用而安装的动产——例如，商店展示柜、餐厅设备）。

(选项 D) 作为妻子的个人代表，外甥可以在妻子去世后的合理时间内合法地移除该水晶吊灯。

教学目标： 如果满足以下条件，终身保有人（或其个人代表）可以在终身地产权终止后的合理时间内移除被添附的动产：
  • 终身保有人无意永久性地添附该动产，且
  • 其移除不会造成实质性损害。


References

  • Restatement (First) of Property § 122 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (life tenant's right to remove fixtures).
  • Restatement (Second) of Property: Landlord & Tenant § 12.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1977) (tenant's rights and obligations as to physical changes to the property).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Fixtures
Rights in Real Property Fixtures (定着物)

本题考察的核心法律问题是：终身保有人 (Life Tenant) 是否有权移除其安装在不动产上的定着物 (Fixtures)？

⚖️ 核心法则 (The Rule) 当终身保有人将动产 (Chattel) 附着于不动产时，如果满足以下条件，该动产不成为不动产的永久部分，保有人（或其个人代表）有权将其移除：
  • 意图 (Intent)： 安装者无意将其永久赠予给剩余财产权人 (Remainderman)。
  • 损害 (Damage)： 移除不会对不动产造成实质性损害。
  • 时间 (Timing)： 必须在终身地产权终止后的合理时间内移除。

📝 案情拆解

1
安装者的身份：
妻子是终身保有人 (Life Tenant)，而非完全保有权人 (Fee Simple Owner)。法律对终身保有人移除定着物的权利通常比普通租户更宽松，因为他们知道自己的权益是暂时的。
2
主观意图 (Intent)：
妻子安装的是家族传家宝 (Heirloom)，并明确指示死后换回原灯具。这清楚地表明她没有将吊灯永久附着于房屋的意图 (No intent to annex permanently)。
3
移除行为：
外甥作为个人代表 (Personal Representative)，在妻子死后不久 (shortly after) 进行了移除。这符合“合理时间”的要求。且题目未提及移除造成了房屋损坏。
✅ 结论：外甥胜诉 (Option A)
因为他有权在合理时间内移除未被永久添附的动产。
为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 B (Doctrine of Accession):
添附原则 (Accession) 通常指动产与不动产结合得如此紧密，以至于无法分离，从而导致动产所有权转移给不动产所有人。本案中吊灯可以被移除且无损毁，因此不适用该原则。如果适用，胜诉的应该是儿子（不动产所有人）。
❌ 选项 C (Trade Fixtures Only):
这是一个常见的干扰项。虽然“营业定着物” (Trade Fixtures) 确实允许商业租户移除，但终身保有人移除定着物的权利不限于商业用途。家庭装饰类定着物 (Domestic fixtures) 只要符合意图测试，同样可以移除。
❌ 选项 D (Cannot be removed after death):
法律允许终身保有人的个人代表在终身权益终止后的一段合理时间 (Reasonable Time) 内进入房产移除定着物。权利并不会在死亡瞬间立即消失。
MBE Tips: 在定着物问题中，安装者的“意图”通常是决定性因素，尤其是当安装者是租户或终身保有人时。

questions.question:
An architect and a developer own adjacent parcels of land. On each of their parcels was a low-rise office building. The two office buildings were of the same height.
Last year the developer decided to demolish the low-rise office building on her parcel and to erect a new high-rise office building of substantially greater height on her parcel as permitted by the zoning and building ordinances. She secured all the governmental approvals necessary to pursue her project.
As the developer's new building was in the course of construction, the architect realized that the shadows it would create would place the architect's building in such deep shade that the rent she could charge for space in her building would be substantially reduced.
The architect brought an appropriate action against the developer to enjoin the construction in order to eliminate the shadow problem and for damages. The architect presented uncontroverted evidence that her evaluation as to the impact of the shadow on the fair rental value of her building was correct. There is no statute or ordinance (other than the building and zoning ordinances) that is applicable to the issues before the court.
How should the court rule?

choices.a: Award the architect damages measured by the loss of rental value, but not an injunction.
choices.b: Grant judgment for the developer, because she had secured all the necessary governmental approvals for the new building.
choices.c: Grant judgment for the developer, because the architect has no legal right to have sunshine continue to reach the windows of her building.
choices.d: Grant the architect the requested injunction.

How should the court rule?

一位建筑师和一位开发商拥有相邻的地块。在他们各自的地块上，都有一座低层办公楼。这两座办公楼高度相同。

去年，开发商决定拆除其地块上的低层办公楼，并根据分区和建筑条例的许可，在其地块上建造一座高度显著增加的新高层办公楼。她获得了推进其项目所需的所有政府批准。

当开发商的新建筑正在施工时，建筑师意识到其产生的阴影将使她的建筑处于极深的阴影中，从而导致她可以收取的建筑空间租金大幅下降。

建筑师对开发商提起了适当的诉讼，要求禁止施工以消除阴影问题，并要求损害赔偿。建筑师出示了无可争议的证据，证明她对阴影影响其建筑公平租赁价值的评估是正确的。除了建筑和分区条例之外，没有其他法规或条例适用于法院审理的这些问题。

法院应如何裁决？
options:
A. Award the architect damages measured by the loss of rental value, but not an injunction.
判给建筑师以租金价值损失计算的损害赔偿，但不发布禁令。

B. Grant judgment for the developer, because she had secured all the necessary governmental approvals for the new building.
作出对开发商有利的判决，因为她已获得新建筑所需的所有政府批准。

C. Grant judgment for the developer, because the architect has no legal right to have sunshine continue to reach the windows of her building.
作出对开发商有利的判决，因为建筑师没有法律权利要求阳光持续照射到其建筑的窗户。

D. Grant the architect the requested injunction.
准予建筑师所请求的禁令。

Remedies for nuisance & easement actions


Temporary nuisancePermanent nuisanceMisuse / interference of easement

InjunctionAvailableN/AAvailable
Self-helpAvailableN/AAvailable
ForfeitureN/AUnavailable unless injunction will not relieve servient estate
At English common law, a landowner's right to light was protected as a prescriptive negative easement under the Doctrine of Ancient Lights. This doctrine has been rejected in the United States. Courts also generally decline to recognize blockage of light as a public or private nuisance unless the blockage was motivated by malice. As a result, landowners only have a right to light if they are protected by statute or enter into an express agreement with the other landowner to create a negative easement (ie, restrictive covenant).

Here, the architect sought to prevent the developer from blocking the light to the architect's building. However, there is no indication that the developer is erecting a high-rise building out of malice or that the architect has obtained a negative easement or covenant from the developer. There is also no statute prohibiting interference with the light. Therefore, the court should grant judgment for the developer because the architect has no legal right to the light reaching her windows (Choices A & D).

(Choice B) The fact that the developer had secured all the necessary governmental approvals does not allow her to bar others from exercising their legal rights. Therefore, this fact would not prevent the architect from prevailing in a lawsuit had she had a legal right to continued access to the light.

Educational objective: A landowner only has a right to light if (1) this right is protected by statute or (2) the landowner enters into an express agreement with the other landowner to create a negative easement or covenant.

根据英国普通法，土地所有者的采光权作为一种时效性消极地役权，受到“古老采光权原则”(Doctrine of Ancient Lights)的保护。该原则已在美国被摒弃。法院通常也拒绝将采光受阻认定为公共或私人妨害，除非该阻挡行为是出于恶意。因此，土地所有者仅在以下情况下享有采光权：该权利受法规保护，或与另一土地所有者签订明确协议以设立消极地役权（即限制性契约）。

在本案中，建筑师试图阻止开发商遮挡其建筑的采光。然而，没有迹象表明开发商是出于恶意建造高层建筑，也没有迹象表明建筑师已从开发商处获得了消极地役权或契约。也没有法规禁止干涉采光。因此，法院应作出对开发商有利的判决，因为建筑师对其窗户的采光没有法律权利（选项 A 和 D）。

（选项 B）开发商已获得所有必要的政府批准这一事实，并不允许她阻止他人行使其合法权利。因此，如果建筑师对持续的采光享有法律权利，这一事实并不能阻止她在诉讼中胜诉。

教学目的：土地所有者仅在以下情况下享有采光权：（1）该权利受法规保护，或（2）土地所有者与另一土地所有者签订明确协议以设立消极地役权或契约。

References

Mohr v. Midas Realty Corp., 431 N.W.2d 380, 382 (Iowa 1988) (explaining that every state has rejected the Doctrine of Ancient Lights).

Sher v. Leiderman, 226 Cal. Rptr. 698, 701 (Ct. App. 1986) (holding that blockage of light is not an actionable nuisance except in cases of malice).

data.htmlContent:
核心考点：采光权
Rights to Light and Air

本题考察的是美国不动产法中关于相邻土地所有者是否有权要求获得阳光照射（即采光权）的经典规则。

1. 法律原则解析

一般规则：
在美国，土地所有者没有获得阳光、空气或景观穿过邻居土地的自然权利。

这与英国普通法中的“古老采光权原则” (Doctrine of Ancient Lights) 截然不同。在美国，法院普遍拒绝承认通过时效取得采光地役权 (Prescriptive Easement for Light)。

这意味着，只要邻居的建设行为符合当地的分区条例 (Zoning Ordinances)，且不是出于纯粹的恶意，他们就有权在自己的土地上进行建设，即使这会挡住你的阳光。

2. 案情分析与正确答案

正确答案是 C。

推理逻辑：

  • 现状：开发商 (Developer) 正在合法建造高层建筑。
  • 后果：新建筑的阴影损害了建筑师 (Architect) 的租金收益。
  • 关键点：题目明确指出没有相关的法规保护采光，双方也没有签订协议。

因此，建筑师没有法律依据 (Legal Right) 要求阳光持续照射其窗户。既然没有权利被侵犯，法院就不会判给损害赔偿 (Damages)，也不会发布禁令 (Injunction)。

3. 为什么其他选项是错的？

❌ 选项 A (判赔偿但不禁令)：
只有在存在法律上的侵权行为 (Tort) 或违约行为时，才会有损害赔偿。既然开发商有权建造，建筑师的损失属于“无损之伤” (Damnum Absque Injuria)——即虽然有经济损失，但法律不予救济。

❌ 选项 B (因为获得了政府批准)：
这是一个常见的干扰项。虽然开发商获得了批准是一个有利事实，但它不是开发商胜诉的根本法律原因。如果建筑师拥有有效的“消极地役权” (Negative Easement)，即使开发商有政府批准，建筑师依然可以胜诉。开发商胜诉的根本原因是建筑师本身缺乏采光权。

❌ 选项 D (发布禁令)：
同选项 A，没有权利受损，就没有救济措施。

4. MBE 考试通关秘籍

在处理此类“邻里纠纷”题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 看合同：是否有书面的消极地役权 (Negative Easement) 或限制性契约 (Restrictive Covenant) 禁止遮挡阳光？
  2. 看恶意：是否构成“恶意围栏” (Spite Fence)？即邻居建造该结构的唯一目的是为了伤害他人，而无任何使用价值。（本题中开发商是为了商业利益，故不构成恶意）。
  3. 看妨害：单纯的阻挡光线通常不构成私人妨害 (Private Nuisance)。
结论：如果没有合同，也没有恶意，在美国法下，你通常无权阻止邻居建楼挡光。

questions.question:
A landowner orally gave his neighbor permission to share the use of a private road on the landowner's land so that the neighbor could have more convenient access to the neighbor's land. Only the landowner maintained the road. After the neighbor had used the road on a daily basis for three years, the landowner conveyed his land to a grantee, who immediately notified the neighbor that the neighbor was not to use the road. The neighbor sued the grantee, seeking a declaration that the neighbor had a right to continue to use the road.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.a: The grantee, because an oral license is invalid.
choices.b: The grantee, because the neighbor had a license that the grantee could terminate at any time.
choices.c: The neighbor, because the grantee is estopped from terminating the neighbor's use of the road.
choices.d: The neighbor, because the neighbor's use of the road was open and notorious when the grantee purchased the land.

data.questionStem:
Q86191

A landowner orally gave his neighbor permission to share the use of a private road on the landowner's land so that the neighbor could have more convenient access to the neighbor's land. Only the landowner maintained the road. After the neighbor had used the road on a daily basis for three years, the landowner conveyed his land to a grantee, who immediately notified the neighbor that the neighbor was not to use the road. The neighbor sued the grantee, seeking a declaration that the neighbor had a right to continue to use the road.

Who is likely to prevail?

一位土地所有者口头允许其邻居共享使用其土地上的一条私人道路，以便邻居可以更方便地进入其邻居的土地。只有该土地所有者维护这条道路。邻居每天使用该道路三年后，土地所有者将其土地转让给了一位受让人。受让人立即通知邻居不得再使用该道路。邻居起诉了受让人，请求法院宣告其有权继续使用该道路。

谁可能胜诉？
options:
A. The grantee, because an oral license is invalid.
受让人，因为口头许可是无效的。

B. The grantee, because the neighbor had a license that the grantee could terminate at any time.
受让人，因为邻居拥有的许可，受让人可以随时终止。

C. The neighbor, because the grantee is estopped from terminating the neighbor's use of the road.
邻居，因为根据禁止反言原则，受让人不得终止邻居对道路的使用。

D. The neighbor, because the neighbor's use of the road was open and notorious when the grantee purchased the land.
邻居，因为在受让人购买土地时，邻居对道路的使用是公开且众所周知的。
data.explanation:
Licenses, easements & profits


LicenseRevocable privilege to enter & use another's land for specific purpose
EasementNonpossessory interest in land that gives easement holder right to:
  • use another's land for specific purpose (ie, affirmative easement) or
  • prohibit other owner from doing something on land that owner would otherwise be allowed to do (ie, negative easement)
ProfitNonpossessory interest in land that gives profit holder right to enter another's land to remove products of soil (eg, timber, minerals, oil)
A license is a grant of permission to enter and use another's land for a specific purpose. Unlike easements, licenses do not create an interest in the land. As a result, they are not subject to the statute of frauds and can be created orally or by another act demonstrating the licensor's intent to let the licensee enter the property (Choice A). Licenses can generally be revoked at any time and terminate automatically upon:
  • the death of either party or
  • conveyance of the licensed property.

Here, the landowner orally gave his neighbor permission to use a private road on his land. This created a license, which terminated automatically when the landowner conveyed his land to the grantee. Additionally, the grantee's immediately notifying the neighbor to stop using the road demonstrates that the grantee did not intend to revive the license. As a result, the neighbor has no right to continue to use the road, and the grantee is likely to prevail.

(Choice C) A license may become irrevocable, and the licensor may be estopped (ie, precluded) from revoking it, if the licensee expends substantial money, labor, or other resources in reliance on the license. But estoppel does not apply here since the landowner alone maintained the road and there is nothing to suggest that the neighbor expended any resources to use it.

(Choice D) Open and notorious use goes to determining whether a prescriptive easement was acquired. But the neighbor's use of the road was with the landowner's permission, which negates the nonpermissive use required for such an easement.

Educational objective: A license is a grant of permission to enter and use another's land for a specific purpose. It can be revoked at any time and terminates automatically upon:
  • the death of either party or
  • conveyance of the licensed property.


选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 89%（正确选项），C选项 4%，D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

许可、地役权与收益权 (Licenses, easements & profits)


许可 (License)为特定目的进入和使用他人土地的可撤销特权
地役权 (Easement)一种非占有性的土地权益，赋予地役权持有人以下权利：
  • 为特定目的使用他人土地（即，肯定性地役权）或
  • 禁止其他土地所有者在其土地上从事其本可以从事的某些行为（即，否定性地役权）
收益权 (Profit)一种非占有性的土地权益，赋予收益权持有人进入他人土地以取走土地产出物（例如，木材、矿产、石油）的权利
许可 (license) 是授予为特定目的进入和使用他人土地的准许。与地役权不同，许可不会在土地上创设权益。因此，它们不受《反欺诈法》(Statute of Frauds) 的约束，可以通过口头方式或通过证明许可人意图让被许可人进入该财产的其他行为来创设（选项A）。许可通常可以随时被撤销，并在以下情况下自动终止：
  • 任何一方死亡或
  • 已许可财产的转让。

在本案中，土地所有者口头允许其邻居使用其土地上的一条私人道路。这创设了一项许可，该许可在土地所有者将其土地转让给受让人时自动终止。此外，受让人立即通知邻居停止使用道路，表明受让人无意恢复该许可。因此，邻居无权继续使用该道路，受让人可能胜诉。

（选项C） 如果被许可人因信赖许可而投入了大量金钱、劳力或其他资源，则该许可可能变为不可撤销，且许可人可能根据禁止反言原则（即，被阻止）不得撤销该许可。但禁止反言原则在此不适用，因为只有土地所有者维护道路，没有证据表明邻居为使用该道路投入了任何资源。

（选项D） 公开且众所周知的使用是判断是否取得了时效地役权 (prescriptive easement) 的一个要素。但邻居对道路的使用是经土地所有者许可的，这否定了获得此类地役权所需的非经许可的使用。

教学目标：许可是授予为特定目的进入和使用他人土地的准许。它可以随时被撤销，并在以下情况下自动终止：
  • 任何一方死亡或
  • 已许可财产的转让。


References

Restatement of Property §§ 515, 519 (Am. Law Inst. 1944) (creation and revocation of licenses).

Rau v. Collins, 891 A.2d 1175, 1184 (Md. App. 2006) (stating that a license terminates automatically upon sale of the licensed land).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

不动产法：许可 vs. 地役权

✅ 正确答案：B

受让人胜诉。因为邻居持有的是一份许可 (License)，该许可在土地转让时自动终止，或者受让人有权随时撤销。

核心概念：许可 (License)

许可是进入或许可使用他人土地的特权 (Privilege)，而非土地权益 (Interest in land)。

  • 形式：通常是口头的 (Oral)。
  • 可撤销性：原则上可随时撤销 (Revocable at will)。
  • 不可转让性：通常是个人的 (Personal)，不可转让。
  • 终止：当土地被出售/转让 (Conveyance) 时，原有的许可自动终止。
1. 权利的定性：
题目中，土地所有者“口头允许” (Orally gave permission) 邻居使用道路。这种口头的、基于人情的准许，在法律上被认定为许可 (License)，而不是地役权 (Easement)。地役权通常需要书面形式以满足《反欺诈法》(Statute of Frauds)。
2. 土地转让的后果：
当原土地所有者将土地转让给受让人 (Grantee) 时，法律规则规定：许可随土地转让而自动终止。因此，受让人没有义务继续允许邻居使用道路。

许可 vs. 地役权

特征 许可 (License) 地役权 (Easement)
性质 一种特权 (Privilege) 土地权益 (Property Interest)
创建方式 口头即可 (Oral is OK) 通常需书面 (Writing required)
撤销 随时可撤销 (Revocable) 不可随意撤销

为什么其他选项是错的？

❌ 选项 A (无效论)： 口头许可并非“无效”，它是有效的，只是它很脆弱，可以被随时撤销。
❌ 选项 C (禁止反言 Estoppel)： 如果被许可人投入了大量资金或劳力 (Detrimental Reliance)，许可可能变为不可撤销 (Irrevocable License)。但本题明确指出“只有土地所有者维护道路”，邻居没有投入成本，因此不适用禁止反言原则。
❌ 选项 D (时效地役权 Prescriptive Easement)： 时效地役权要求使用是“敌意的” (Hostile/Adverse)。本题中邻居的使用是经过许可的 (Permissive)，许可的存在直接否定了敌意性，因此无法形成时效地役权。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 看到 "Oral permission" (口头允许) 使用土地，第一反应应当是 License (许可)。

紧接着检查是否有 Reliance (信赖利益/投入资金)：
  • 如果有投入 -> Irrevocable License (Estoppel)
  • 如果没有投入 -> Revocable at will (随时可撤销)

questions.question:
A woman acquired land by a deed that contained the following language in the grantee section: "to [the woman], her heirs and assigns, provided, however, that said grantee may not transfer any interest in the land for 10 years from the date of this instrument."
Two years later, the woman contracted to sell the land to an investor for a price based on a recent appraisal. When the investor's title search revealed the above language in the grantee section of the deed to the woman, the investor refused to close the transaction. The contract was silent as to the woman's title obligation.
The woman has sued the investor for specific performance.
Who is likely to prevail?

choices.a: The investor, because the woman cannot sell the land during the 10-year period specified in the deed.
choices.b: The investor, because the woman's heirs did not join in the contract.
choices.c: The woman, because the contract did not obligate her to provide marketable title.
choices.d: The woman, because the deed's restraint on transfer is void as a matter of law.

Two years later, the woman contracted to sell the land to an investor for a price based on a recent appraisal. When the investor's title search revealed the above language in the grantee section of the deed to the woman, the investor refused to close the transaction. The contract was silent as to the woman's title obligation.

The woman has sued the investor for specific performance.

Who is likely to prevail? 一名女子通过一份契约获得了一块土地，契约的受让人部分包含以下语言：“授予[该女子]、其继承人和受让人，但前提是，所述受让人自本文件签订之日起10年内不得转让该土地的任何权益。”

两年后，该女子签订合同，以近期评估价为基础将该土地出售给一名投资者。当投资者的产权调查发现授予该女子的契约受让人部分存在上述语言时，投资者拒绝完成交易。合同对该女子的产权义务未作规定。

该女子已起诉投资者，要求其强制履行合同。

谁可能胜诉？
options:
A. The investor, because the woman cannot sell the land during the 10-year period specified in the deed.
投资者，因为该女子在契约规定的10年期限内不能出售该土地。

B. The investor, because the woman's heirs did not join in the contract.
投资者，因为该女子的继承人没有加入合同。

C. The woman, because the contract did not obligate her to provide marketable title.
该女子，因为合同没有规定她必须提供可售卖产权。

D. The woman, because the deed's restraint on transfer is void as a matter of law.
该女子，因为契约中的转让限制在法律上是无效的。
data.explanation:
Restraints on alienation

(restrictions on transferability of real property)
ValidityExamples
Direct
(disfavored)		Only valid if reasonable
Balance utility of restraint against harm resulting from enforcement		Prohibiting some or all types of transfers
Prohibiting transfer without consent
Prohibiting transfer to particular persons
IndirectValid unless lacking rational justificationImposing transfer fees
Limiting property's use/reducing its value
A restraint on alienation is a provision that restricts the transferability of real property. Direct restraints on alienation (eg, a restriction that prohibits some or all types of transfers—as seen here) are disfavored and are valid only if they are deemed reasonable. To determine reasonableness, courts weigh the utility of the restraint against the harm resulting from its enforcement. A total restraint on the alienability of a fee simple estate is always unreasonable because freedom of alienation is a defining attribute of this type of estate.

Here, the woman's deed states that she may not transfer any interest in the land for 10 years, which constitutes a direct and total restraint on alienation. But the woman has a fee simple estate in the land—as evidenced by the words of limitation "and her heirs" traditionally used to convey this type of estate. Therefore, the deed's restraint on transfer is a void restraint on alienation of a fee simple estate, and the woman can sell the land to the investor (Choice A). As a result, she is likely to prevail in her suit against the investor for specific performance.

(Choice B) The words "and her heirs" are used to convey a fee simple estate, but they do not create an ownership interest in the grantee's heirs or make them the only persons to whom the grantee can transfer the estate. Therefore, the woman's heirs need not join the contract for it to be enforceable.

(Choice C) In contracts for the sale of land, the seller has an implied obligation to the buyer to deliver marketable title—ie, title that is reasonably free from doubt and not under threat of litigation. Therefore, it does not matter that the contract here did not expressly obligate the woman to provide marketable title.

转让限制

(对不动产可转让性的限制)
有效性示例
直接限制
（不受欢迎）		仅在合理的情况下有效
权衡限制的效用与强制执行所造成的损害		禁止部分或所有类型的转让
禁止未经同意的转让
禁止向特定人士转让
间接限制有效，除非缺乏合理解释征收转让费
限制财产的使用/降低其价值
转让限制是限制不动产可转让性的条款。对转让的直接限制（例如，禁止部分或所有类型的转让的限制——如此处所示）是不受欢迎的，并且仅当被认为是合理的时才有效。为了确定合理性，法院会权衡限制的效用与强制执行所造成的损害。对完全保有地产的可转让性进行完全限制是始终不合理的，因为转让自由是此类地产的一个决定性特征。

在此案中，该女子的契约规定，她在10年内不得转让土地的任何权益，这构成了对转让的直接和完全限制。但该女子对该土地拥有完全保有地产——这由传统上用于传达此类地产的限定词语“及其继承人”所证明。因此，契约中的转让限制是对完全保有地产的转让的无效限制，该女子可以向投资者出售该土地（选项A）。因此，在她对投资者提起的强制履行诉讼中，她很可能胜诉。

（选项B）“及其继承人”这些词语用于传达完全保有地产，但它们并未在受让人的继承人中创造所有权权益，也未使他们成为受让人可以向其转让地产的唯一人士。因此，该女子的继承人无需加入合同以使其可执行。

（选项C）在土地销售合同中，卖方对买方负有默示义务，即交付可售卖产权——即，产权合理地无疑问且不受诉讼威胁。因此，本案合同没有明确规定该女子有义务提供可售卖产权并不重要。

Educational objective:
Direct restraints on alienation (eg, prohibitions on some or all types of transfers) are valid only if they are deemed reasonable. Total restraints on the alienability of fee simple estates are always unreasonable.

References
Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 3.4 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (direct restraints on alienation).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Restraints on Alienation

核心法律规则

本题考察的是不动产法中关于转让限制 (Restraints on Alienation) 的规则。

一般规则：
法律倾向于财产的自由流通。因此，对绝对完全保有地产权 (Fee Simple Absolute) 施加的直接转让限制通常是不受法律支持的。

转让限制主要分为三类：

  • 禁止性限制 (Disabling Restraint)：规定转让无效。
  • 没收性限制 (Forfeiture Restraint)：规定若转让则失去产权。
  • 承诺性限制 (Promissory Restraint)：合同承诺不转让。

MBE 黄金法则：
对于 Fee Simple Estate（完全保有地产），任何试图完全禁止转让（哪怕是暂时的，如10年）的条款都是无效的 (Void)。

图解：限制的有效性
Fee Simple
(完全保有地产)

完全禁止转让
(Total Restraint)
⬇
无效 (Void)
Life Estate
(终身地产)

合理的没收性限制
(Forfeiture Restraint)
⬇
可能有效 (Valid)

*注：本题属于左侧情况。虽然只是10年的限制，但对于Fee Simple来说，禁止任何形式的转让被视为“完全限制”，因此无效。

本案逻辑推演
1
确定地产类型：
契约使用了 "to [the woman], her heirs and assigns"（授予该女子、其继承人和受让人）。这是设立 Fee Simple Absolute 的经典语言。
2
识别限制条款：
条款规定 "may not transfer... for 10 years"（10年内不得转让）。这属于直接的转让限制。
3
应用法律后果：
由于这是对 Fee Simple 的直接限制，该限制条款自始无效 (Void ab initio)。
4
结论：
既然限制无效，该女子拥有完全的处分权。她可以出售土地，且产权是清晰的。因此，她有权要求强制履行 (Specific Performance)。
为什么选 D？

正确答案 D 指出契约中的转让限制在法律上是无效的。这直接切中了问题的核心：虽然契约里写了不让卖，但这行字在法律眼中是“透明”的，不产生效力。

其他选项为何错误？

  • 选项 A (错误)： 认为限制有效。这是对法律规则的误解，Fee Simple 上的 Total Restraint 总是无效的。
  • 选项 B (错误)： 提到“继承人未加入合同”。在 "to A and her heirs" 中，"and her heirs" 是限定词 (Words of Limitation)，仅表示地产的类型是永久的，并不给继承人任何当前的权益。继承人无权干涉买卖。
  • 选项 C (错误)： 认为合同未规定“可售卖产权 (Marketable Title)”。实际上，所有土地销售合同都默示 (Implied) 包含提供 Marketable Title 的义务，除非明确排除。沉默不代表没有义务。
MBE 提分锦囊
  • 🚩 看到 "Heirs" 不要慌： 只要出现在 "To A and her heirs" 这种格式里，它只是用来定义 Fee Simple 的，继承人没有任何权利 (No interest)。
  • 🚩 区分限制类型：
    • 如果是 Fee Simple + 禁止转让 ➡ 限制无效，可以卖。
    • 如果是 Co-tenancy (共有) + 协议限制分割 ➡ 如果时间合理，可能有效。
    • 如果是 Right of First Refusal (优先购买权) ➡ 如果价格合理且期限合理，通常有效。
  • 🚩 Marketable Title： 永远默示存在。如果题目说“合同没写”，不要以为就没有这个义务。

questions.question:
Ten years ago, a couple bought a building and moved into its second-floor apartment with their teenage daughter. The couple operated a shoe store on the first floor of the building for many years. When the couple purchased the building, the area was predominantly rural and was zoned for nonresidential use. The municipality's zoning is cumulative.
Five years ago, the municipality rezoned the area to single-family residential use. The daughter was not aware of this change because she was away at college.
Recently, the daughter inherited the building from her parents. The daughter immediately moved into the apartment and took over the operation of the shoe store on the first floor. The daughter has learned that a developer is planning to build a large residential community in the area surrounding her building.
The daughter has asked her lawyer for advice regarding her ability to continue operating the shoe store.
Should the lawyer advise the daughter that she can continue to operate her shoe store?

choices.a: No, because the nonconforming use of the building terminated when the daughter's parents died.
choices.b: No, but the municipality must pay her reasonable compensation for her loss resulting from the change in zoning.
choices.c: Yes, because the shoe store is a nonconforming use.
choices.d: Yes, because the zoning is cumulative and the building is also used for single-family residential purposes.

data.questionStem:
Q86822 Ten years ago, a couple bought a building and moved into its second-floor apartment with their teenage daughter. The couple operated a shoe store on the first floor of the building for many years. When the couple purchased the building, the area was predominantly rural and was zoned for nonresidential use. The municipality's zoning is cumulative.

Five years ago, the municipality rezoned the area to single-family residential use. The daughter was not aware of this change because she was away at college.

Recently, the daughter inherited the building from her parents. The daughter immediately moved into the apartment and took over the operation of the shoe store on the first floor. The daughter has learned that a developer is planning to build a large residential community in the area surrounding her building.

The daughter has asked her lawyer for advice regarding her ability to continue operating the shoe store.

Should the lawyer advise the daughter that she can continue to operate her shoe store? 十年前，一对夫妇买下了一栋楼，并与他们十几岁的女儿一起搬进了二楼的公寓。这对夫妇在该楼的一楼经营鞋店多年。当这对夫妇购买这栋楼时，该地区主要为乡村地区，并被划为非住宅用途区。该市的区划是累积性的。

五年前，该市将该地区重新划为单户住宅用途区。女儿对此变更不知情，因为她当时在外地上大学。

最近，女儿从父母那里继承了这栋楼。女儿立即搬进了公寓，并接管了一楼鞋店的经营。女儿了解到，一位开发商正计划在她的大楼周围地区建造一个大型住宅社区。

女儿向她的律师咨询了关于她是否能继续经营鞋店的建议。

律师是否应该建议女儿她可以继续经营她的鞋店？
options:
A. No, because the nonconforming use of the building terminated when the daughter's parents died.
不应该，因为当女儿的父母去世时，该建筑的不合规定用途已经终止。

B. No, but the municipality must pay her reasonable compensation for her loss resulting from the change in zoning.
不应该，但市政府必须为她因区划变更而造成的损失支付合理补偿。

C. Yes, because the shoe store is a nonconforming use.
应该，因为鞋店是一种不合规定用途。

D. Yes, because the zoning is cumulative and the building is also used for single-family residential purposes.
应该，因为区划是累积性的，并且该建筑也用于单户住宅目的。
data.explanation:
A nonconforming use arises when property was used in a lawful manner before a zoning law was enacted or amended and that use continues even though it is now prohibited by the zoning law. When this occurs, the owner of the nonconforming use has a "grandfathered right" to continue that use until (1) it is enlarged, changed, or abandoned or (2) if provided in the zoning law, the amortization period has passed or the nonconforming use has not been registered.

Here, the building was in an area zoned for nonresidential use when the couple began to lawfully operate a shoe store. When the area was rezoned to single-family residential use, the shoe store became a nonconforming use. And since the shoe store was continuously operated by the couple and then their daughter—and there is no indication that the zoning law has an amortization period or registration requirement—the daughter should be advised that she can continue to operate her shoe store (Choice A).

(Choice B) Under the Fifth Amendment takings clause, the municipality would have been required to pay the daughter reasonable compensation had the zoning law taken her private property for public use (eg, by depriving her property of its economic value). But since the law does not affect the daughter's operation of the shoe store, no compensation is required.

(Choice D) Zoning is cumulative when it allows a higher use to exist in a lower use zone, as illustrated above. Here, the area was rezoned to the highest use (residential), so the shoe store's lower use (commercial) cannot exist in that zone. This is true even though the building also has a residential use since that other use does not change the commercial character of the store.

Educational objective: A nonconforming use may continue until (1) the owner enlarges, changes, or abandons that use or (2) if provided in the zoning law, an amortization period has passed or the use has not been registered.



当一项财产在区划法制定或修订之前以合法方式使用，并且即使该用途现在已被区划法禁止，但仍在继续使用时，就会产生不合规定用途。当这种情况发生时，不合规定用途的所有者拥有“祖父权利”，可以继续该用途，直到（1）该用途被扩大、改变或放弃，或者（2）如果区划法有规定，摊销期已过或该不合规定用途未被登记。

在本案中，当这对夫妇开始合法经营鞋店时，该建筑位于一个划为非住宅用途的区域。当该区域被重新划为单户住宅用途区时，该鞋店就成了一种不合规定用途。并且，由于鞋店由这对夫妇及其女儿持续经营——而且没有迹象表明区划法有摊销期或登记要求——因此应建议女儿她可以继续经营她的鞋店（选项A）。

（选项B）根据第五修正案的征用条款，如果区划法为公共用途征用了她的私有财产（例如，通过剥夺其财产的经济价值），市政府则必须向女儿支付合理补偿。但由于该法律不影响女儿对鞋店的经营，因此不需要补偿。

（选项D）当区划允许更高等级的用途存在于更低等级的用途区时，该区划就是累积性的，如上所述。在本案中，该区域被重新划为最高等级的用途（住宅），因此鞋店的较低等级用途（商业）不能存在于该区域。即使该建筑也有住宅用途，这一点仍然成立，因为另一用途不会改变商店的商业性质。

教学目标： 不合规定用途可以继续，直到（1）所有者扩大、改变或放弃该用途，或者（2）如果区划法有规定，摊销期已过或该用途未被登记。

References

Pa. Nw. Distribs., Inc. v. Zoning Hearing Bd., 584 A.2d 1372, 1375–76 (Pa. 1991) (describing the right to and termination of a nonconforming use).

83 Am. Jur. 2d Zoning & Planning §§ 524–93 (2019).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Zoning
✅ 正确答案：C

是的，因为鞋店属于不合规定用途 (Nonconforming Use)，享有继续经营的权利。

核心概念：不合规定用途 (Nonconforming Use)

当政府修改区划法（Zoning Ordinance）时，如果某项财产在修改之前已经合法存在并使用，但修改后不再符合新的区划要求，该用途即成为不合规定用途。

⚖️ 法律规则：
不合规定用途的所有者拥有“祖父权利”（Grandfathered Right），可以继续该用途，直到：
  1. 用途被扩大、改变或放弃 (Abandoned)；
  2. 或者（如果法律规定）摊销期 (Amortization Period) 已过。
本案逻辑推演
  • 1
    初始状态合法：
    10年前购买时，该区域划为非住宅区，经营鞋店是合法的 (Lawful)。
  • 2
    区划变更：
    5年前，区域被重新划为“单户住宅区” (Single-family residential)。此时鞋店变得不合规。
  • 3
    持续使用：
    鞋店一直由父母经营，随后由女儿接手，中间没有中断，也没有扩大规模或改变性质。

结论：女儿有权继续经营。

为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 A：父母去世导致权利终止？

错误。 不合规定用途是随土地转移的 (Runs with the land)，而不是随人转移的。只要用途本身没有被放弃（Abandonment），所有权的变更（如继承、出售）不会终止该权利。

❌ 选项 D：累积性区划 (Cumulative Zoning)？

错误。 这是一个常见的陷阱。

Cumulative Zoning 通常意味着：
高级别用途（如住宅）可以存在于低级别区域（如商业/工业区）。

但在本案中，情况正好相反：试图在高级别区域（住宅区）保留低级别用途（商业鞋店）。无论区划是否是累积性的，商业用途通常都不允许在纯住宅区存在，除非它是不合规定用途。因此，C 是比 D 更准确的法律依据。

❌ 选项 B：政府赔偿 (Compensation)？

错误。 只有当区划变更导致财产完全丧失经济价值（Regulatory Taking）时，才需要赔偿。这里女儿仍可居住或继续经营（作为不合规定用途），并未丧失所有价值。

💡 MBE 考试技巧：
看到“Zoning Change”（区划变更）+ “Existing Business”（现有业务）的组合，首先要反应出 Nonconforming Use。

关键判断点： 1. 变更前是否合法？ 2. 使用是否连续（未放弃）？
如果都是 Yes，则受保护。

questions.question:
A man conveyed a valid easement appurtenant across his ranch to a woman who owned the adjoining property, on which she operated a commercial farm. The easement was not recorded. Shortly before his death, the man devised his ranch to his son. The will made no mention of the woman's easement. The son, who lived out-of-state, never came to visit the ranch. The woman decided to expand the size of her crops and openly used the man's ranch to do so. She paid the taxes on the property and used the land exclusively for 20 years. However, she never used the easement during that time.
After facing some financial hardship, the son decided to sell the ranch. To prevent the sale, the woman filed and won a quiet-title suit confirming that she had acquired ownership of the ranch through adverse possession. The son felt guilty about losing his father's ranch, so he worked out a deal with the woman to repurchase the ranch.
After the sale, the woman resumed her use of the easement across the ranch that had been granted to her by the man. The son, already angry over having to repurchase the ranch, immediately objected to the woman entering his property. The woman has filed suit to enforce the easement.
The jurisdiction has a notice recording act.
Will the woman likely prevail?

choices.a: No, because she acquired title to the ranch through adverse possession.
choices.b: No, because the son was not provided proper notice of the easement.
choices.c: Yes, because an easement appurtenant automatically runs with the land.
choices.d: Yes, because failure to use an easement does not extinguish it.

一名男子将其牧场上的一项有效从属地役权（easement appurtenant）转让给了一位拥有相邻土地的女性，该女性在其土地上经营一个商业农场。该地役权未被登记。在去世前不久，该男子通过遗嘱将其牧场遗赠给了他的儿子。遗嘱中没有提及该女性的地役权。儿子住在州外，从未前来探访过该牧场。该女性决定扩大其作物种植规模，并为此公开使用了该男子的牧场。她支付了该地产的税款，并独占地使用了该土地长达20年。然而，在此期间她从未使用过该地役权。

在遭遇一些财务困境后，儿子决定出售该牧场。为阻止出售，该女性提起并赢得了一场确认产权诉讼，确认她已通过侵权逆占（adverse possession）获得了该牧场的所有权。儿子对于失去父亲的牧场感到内疚，因此他与该女性达成协议，回购了该牧场。

出售后，该女性恢复使用了由该男子授予她的、穿越该牧场的地役权。儿子本就因不得不回购牧场而感到愤怒，他立即反对该女性进入他的地产。该女性已提起诉讼，要求强制执行该地役权。

该司法管辖区实行登记告知法案（notice recording act）。

该女性是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because she acquired title to the ranch through adverse possession.
否，因为她通过侵权逆占获得了该牧场的所有权。

B. No, because the son was not provided proper notice of the easement.
否，因为儿子没有得到关于该地役权的适当通知。

C. Yes, because an easement appurtenant automatically runs with the land.
是，因为从属地役权自动随土地转移。

D. Yes, because failure to use an easement does not extinguish it.
是，因为未使用地役权并不会使其消灭。
data.explanation:
The man granted the woman an easement appurtenant † across his ranch. An easement appurtenant is a nonpossessory right to use another's land (servient estate) that benefits the easement holder's land (dominant estate). This type of easement runs with the land, so it automatically transfers with the conveyance of the dominant or servient estate. But since easements are a real property interest, they are subject to the jurisdiction's recording act.

Under a notice recording act (as seen here), real property interests cannot be enforced against subsequent purchasers of a conflicting real property interest who lack notice of the prior interest. But since the son is not a purchaser for value (he was devised the ranch), he is not protected by the recording act. Therefore, the fact that he was not provided proper notice of the easement is of no consequence (Choice B).

However, the woman's adverse possession of the ranch is of consequence. That is because, under the merger doctrine , an easement will terminate when the dominant estate (the farm) and the servient estate (the ranch) merge into the hands of a single owner. That is because a landowner cannot own an easement across his/her own land. Therefore, the easement was extinguished once the woman acquired title to both the farm and the ranch (Choice C).

Once terminated, an easement cannot be revived by merely resevering the dominant and servient estates - a new easement must be created. Therefore, the woman's easement over the ranch was not revived when she sold the ranch to the son. And since no new easement was created, the woman likely will not prevail in her suit to enforce the easement.

†Easements are presumed to be appurtenant unless otherwise stated.

(Choice D) An easement can be terminated by abandonment if the easement holder acts in an affirmative way that shows a clear intent to relinquish the easement - mere nonuse of the easement is not enough. However, the woman will not prevail because the easement was terminated by merger.

Educational objective: Under the merger doctrine, an easement terminates once the dominant and servient estates merge into the hands of a single owner.



选项正确率统计：A选项 58%（正确选项），B选项 18%，C选项 12%，D选项 11%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

该男子授予了该女性一项穿越其牧场的从属地役权 (easement appurtenant) †。从属地役权是一种为地役权人土地（需役地, dominant estate）的利益而使用他人土地（供役地, servient estate）的非占有性权利。这种类型的地役权随土地转移，因此它会随着需役地或供役地的转让而自动转移。但由于地役权是一种不动产权益，它们受该司法管辖区的登记法案（recording act）约束。

根据登记告知法案（notice recording act）（如本案所示），对于那些对先前存在的权益不知情的、购买了冲突不动产权益的后续购买者，该不动产权益不可强制执行。但由于儿子并非有偿购买者（他是通过遗嘱获赠该牧场），他不受登记法案的保护。因此，他没有得到关于该地役权的适当通知这一事实是无关紧要的 (选项B)。

然而，该女性对牧场的侵权逆占是有影响的。这是因为，根据混同原则 (merger doctrine)，当需役地（农场）和供役地（牧场）合并到同一所有者手中时，地役权将终止。这是因为土地所有者不能在自己的土地上拥有地役权。因此，一旦该女性获得了农场和牧场两者的所有权，地役权即告消灭 (选项C)。

一旦终止，地役权不能仅通过重新分离需役地和供役地而恢复——必须创建一个新的地役权。因此，当她将牧场出售给儿子时，她对该牧场的地役权并未恢复。并且由于没有创建新的地役权，该女性在强制执行地役权的诉讼中很可能不会胜诉。

†除非另有说明，否则地役权均被推定为从属地役权。

(选项D) 如果地役权人以积极行为表明其放弃地役权的明确意图，则地役权可以通过抛弃而终止——仅仅不使用地役权是不够的。然而，该女性不会胜诉，因为地役权已因混同而终止。

教学目标：根据混同原则（merger doctrine），一旦需役地和供役地合并到同一所有者手中，地役权即告终止。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Servitudes § 7.5 (Am. Law Inst. 2000) (termination of easement by merger).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Easement Termination
正确答案：A 否，因为她通过侵权逆占（Adverse Possession）获得了该牧场的所有权。

核心考点是地役权的消灭方式之一：混同原则 (Merger Doctrine)。

逻辑推演 (Legal Reasoning)
1. 初始状态：
女性拥有农场（需役地 Dominant Estate），并拥有穿越牧场（供役地 Servient Estate）的地役权。
2. 侵权逆占 (Adverse Possession)：
女性占有牧场20年并赢得确认产权诉讼（Quiet Title）。此时，她同时拥有了农场和牧场的所有权。
3. 混同 (Merger) 发生：
这是解题的关键点。当需役地和供役地的所有权归于同一人时，地役权自动消灭。因为一个人不能在自己的土地上拥有地役权（你拥有完整的土地所有权，不需要额外的“通过权”）。
4. 出售与结果：
当女性将牧场卖回给儿子时，已消灭的地役权不会自动复活。除非在出售时重新设立（Express Grant/Reservation）或满足默示地役权的条件，否则该地役权不复存在。
排除干扰项 (Distractor Analysis)

❌ 选项 B (Notice / Recording Act):
这是一个经典的 MBE 陷阱。虽然该司法管辖区有登记告知法案，且地役权未登记，但儿子是通过遗嘱继承 (Devise) 获得牧场的，并非“有偿购买者” (Bona Fide Purchaser for Value)。因此，登记法案不保护儿子。但这不重要，因为后续的“混同”才是终结地役权的真正原因。

❌ 选项 C (Runs with the land):
地役权确实通常随土地转移，但前提是该地役权仍然存在。在本案中，地役权在转移前已经因混同而消灭了。

❌ 选项 D (Non-use):
单纯的“不使用”确实不足以消灭地役权（需要有抛弃的意图）。但是，本案中地役权的消灭不是因为不使用，而是因为所有权的混同。

💡 MBE 考试技巧：
当你看到题目中出现“一个人最终拥有了两块相关的土地”（Unity of Ownership）的情节时，立即联想 Merger Doctrine（混同原则）。

记住口诀：Buy the land, kill the easement.（买下供役地，杀死地役权）。一旦消灭，除非重新创建，否则永不复活。
